The bottom line is that opponents of voting rights could easily enact many of the proposed policies from Project 2025. We're focused on the changes to voting and our elections, but there's no doubt that this plan would radically alter our country and our lives into a mix of our inequitable past and an unrecognizable autocracy. The loss of rights might well be irreversible.
We cannot stand by and let Project 2025 become reality. RUSH $25 or more right now to make sure every voter knows about the dangerous consequences of this plan before they vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091624_4&amount=25]

Vox - Project 2025: The myths and the facts [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091624_4&amount=25]
There's been a lot of talk about the Heritage Foundation's "Project 2025", Team. It's time for the truth.
Project 2025 is a detailed and specific plan for what the next Republican president could ( or in the eyes of some, should ) do with his power, including the preparation needed to put the plan into action. Organized by the Heritage Foundation, a right-wing, dark money, inside-the-beltway, anti-voting think tank , and advised by more than 100 conservative groups, Project 2025 has put forth a 922-page list of policy recommendations, going agency by agency in the federal government.
This is not an unattainable "wish list" -- this is carefully crafted to be a list of things the next president’s appointees really can do , put together by many people who served in top posts under Trump last time and could well do so again. Basically, it’s an attempt to make the second Trump term way more organized and effective than the first.
This is a good place to mention that Project 2025 is also collecting a database of names of conservatives who have already pledged loyalty to Donald Trump and could easily take jobs in his potential second term, willing to start executing this plan on day one.
Already heard enough and are willing to help us educate voters across the country about this dangerous and anti-democracy plan? Pitch in $25 or whatever you can now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091624_4&amount=25]
Project 2025 covers a lot of different things, but basically falls into three buckets:
➜ Expanding the power of the president. Various pieces of the plan attempt to consolidate executive branch power in the hands of the president and his political appointees and away from nonpartisan civil service employees and Congress. For example, Donald Trump himself could be directing voter suppression efforts through the Department of Justice.
➜ Long-term conservative policy priorities. Slashing regulations on businesses, especially in regards to the environment. Ending climate change mitigation efforts. Reducing programs to help the poor, like food programs or educational requirements. Eradicating civil rights protections, including access to the ballot and our ability to vote. The list goes on, but if you've heard it from a conservative politician over the last forty years, it's likely in this plan.
➜ An extreme religious agenda. Further federal restrictions on abortion access. New, possibly expansive restrictions on contraception coverage. Outlawing pornography and imprisoning members of that industry. Banning LGBTQ books in libraries. Rolling back or ending LGBTQ programs in schools.
Project 2025 would fundamentally alter just about every aspect of American life . We must make sure every American is aware of what their vote might mean and how this expansive blueprint would truly impact themselves, their friends, and their family before it is time for them to cast a ballot.

When my dad was five years old, he immigrated from Mexico to Texas. He picked cotton and tomatoes in the fields of the Rio Grande Valley, all the while dreaming that one day he would work his way out of poverty and make it to the middle class.
My parents taught me the value of hard work. And I grew up believing that if we worked hard anything was possible.
But when I got to college, I realized my parents didn’t have the money to pay for my tuition and their groceries. So I worked all kinds of odd jobs to put myself through school. It took seven years, but I finished my degree and became the first person in my family to graduate from college.
That got me thinking: How could it be this difficult, when we did everything right? And I know that’s a question on the minds of so many families today across Oregon and our nation.
**I ran for Congress because I believe Oregon deserves leaders who will work hard every day to make life better for all of us. I’ve worked hard to deliver progress, and I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together so far. But if we’re going to make the kind of change the American people deserve, we need to win this battleground seat and flip the House blue. It’s as simple as that.**
If we’re going to reinstate abortion rights in this nation, we need to win this race.
If we’re going to stop another Trump-fueled attempt to overturn the results of the next election, we need to win this race.
If we’re going to make more progress protecting our environment for future generations, we need to win this race.
If we’re going to build an economy that’s fairer for working families — with affordable health care, a livable minimum wage, and paid family leave no matter what state you live in — we need to win this race.

clean_body: \-- | = I’m going to be candid with you: this is a fundraising email. Right now, in our campaign office, we’re celebrating every ping ActBlue makes when a donation comes in. They’re coming at a steady trickle, but we need them pinging off the hook. = | = When my dad was five years old, he immigrated from Mexico to Texas. He picked cotton and tomatoes in the fields of the Rio Grande Valley, all the while dreaming that one day he would work his way out of poverty and make it to the middle class. My parents taught me the value of hard work. And I grew up believing that if we worked hard anything was possible. But when I got to college, I realized my parents didn’t have the money to pay for my tuition and their groceries. So I worked all kinds of odd jobs to put myself through school. It took seven years, but I finished my degree and became the first person in my family to graduate from college. That got me thinking: How could it be this difficult, when we did everything right? And I know that’s a question on the minds of so many families today across Oregon and our nation. I ran for Congress because I believe Oregon deserves leaders who will work hard every day to make life better for all of us. I’ve worked hard to deliver progress, and I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together so far. But if we’re going to make the kind of change the American people deserve, we need to win this battleground seat and flip the House blue. It’s as simple as that. If we’re going to reinstate abortion rights in this nation, we need to win this race. body:
Andrew Yang, Lt. Gov. Kerry Healey, and Lindsey Williams Drath to keynote INC '24

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=inc_follow_up_icymi&n=1)
---
Tuesday, September 17, 2024 | Peter -- **ICYMI** : The Forward Party is going the the [Independent National Convention](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=c0914eQnsP0SXKk1VhTSqwL8KJz26c0lGpvgqkvEcQw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=inc_follow_up_icymi&n=2)! INC '24 is gathering independents from across the nation, who now outnumber Republicans or Democrats _combined_. With our new majority, it's time to get organized and start making a real difference in this country. Forward was founded through three groups coming together to build a new home for Americans sick of the partisan fighting, and we'll be at INC '24 to invite more to join us. Forward Party co-founder Andrew Yang and Executive Chair Lt. Gov. Kerry Healey are delivering the closing keynote remarks at this historic event... but that's not all! The Forward Party will have speakers on stage throughout the conference, explaining what we're doing and how the independents at the convention can be a part of our movement. Check out the [full schedule here](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=c0914eQnsP0SXKk1VhTSqwL8KJz26c0lGpvgqkvEcQw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=inc_follow_up_icymi&n=3)! Before we introduce you to our speakers panel, we want to let you in on a little secret... If you want to attend the conference, there are still tickets available, and our members have access to the **discount code FORWARD50 for $50 off** the [ticket cost](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=c0914eQnsP0SXKk1VhTSqwL8KJz26c0lGpvgqkvEcQw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=inc_follow_up_icymi&n=4)! | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=c0914eQnsP0SXKk1VhTSqwL8KJz26c0lGpvgqkvEcQw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=inc_follow_up_icymi&n=5 "Get Your Tickets Now!") [Get Your Tickets Now!](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=c0914eQnsP0SXKk1VhTSqwL8KJz26c0lGpvgqkvEcQw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=inc_follow_up_icymi&n=5)
---
_Meet your panel of Forward speakers:_
### Andrew Yang
Andrew Yang is a co-founder of the Forward Party. A veteran of U.S. politics, Andrew ran for President and for Mayor of NYC. After those races as a registered Democrat, he saw the dysfunction native to our system and left the party to create a new home for the politically homeless.
### Lt. Gov. Kerry Healey
Lt. Gov. Healey is the Executive Chair of the Forward Party. In her career, she served as the Lt. Governor of Massachusetts under Governor Romney and was the chair of the Massachusetts Republican Party. After witnessing the Republican Party's turn towards extremism, she left and joined Forward to provide better options for the American people.
### Lindsey Williams Drath
Lindsey Williams Drath is the CEO of the Forward party, lending her years of experience as a political operative to our efforts to create a new home for the American. In her time as CEO, she has overseen the development of state parties and the recruitment of high-quality candidates. Her vision and leadership keep us on the Forward path, and she'll be presenting that vision at INC '24.
### Jackie Salit
Jackie Salit is a member of the Forward Party Board of Directors and is a highly respected political innovator and advocate for the rights of independent voters. She serves as the President of IndependentVoting.org, the country’s leading strategy and organizing center for independents, with chapters in 40 states. She also serves as the co-director for the Center for an Independent and Sustainable Democracy at Arizona State University.
### Matt Shinners
Matt has been with Forward since the very beginning. He currently serves as the Chief Strategy and Operations Officer. Prior to Forward, Matt was the Chief of Staff to Andrew Yang's presidential campaign. He's forgotten more about starting a third party than most anyone else has ever learned.
We're so excited to see you all next week. This will be one of the biggest gatherings of independent voters the country has ever seen, and we're honored to be headlining it for you.
Let's keep moving #Forward.

clean_body: How do we win and mobilize working class voters now and in the years to come? | | | Peter, How do we win and mobilize working class voters now and in the years to come? For over a year, we’ve been working alongside our sibling organization Working Families Power to answer that question — and this morning, NBC News published an exclusive report going over some of what we’ve learned: We’ve developed a practical handbook to reach and engage working-class voters across the political spectrum, bringing them into our movement and electing a government that works for the many, not the few. But we have less than two months left to turn our learnings into action before votes are tallied in November’s history-making elections. Republicans want to claim the working class as their own, while at the same time trying to pit these same voters against one another based on their race, religion, or skin color. The working class is not one monolith. It’s our friends, family, and neighbors, with all kinds of jobs, ideologies, ages, and education levels. After over a year of conversations with thousands of working-class people to understand the nuances and competing perspectives of these voters — we’ve taken what we’ve learned and come up with a road map to build relationships with and persuade these voters to turn out for candidates who will fight for them. And we’ve set an ambitious goal of knocking on over 1 million doors and sending over 7 million texts and calls to voters in the handful of states that will decide this election. subject: Rural PA needs a Senator who understands

Hello, Peter.
The future of our rural communities is on the ballot this year.
Pennsylvania has 48 rural counties, and I’m fighting to ensure that each one gets a fair shake and future opportunities.
As Senator, I’m proud to have brought critical investments to small towns across the Commonwealth. I’ve fought for legislation to improve and expand high-speed internet access in all corners of the Commonwealth. I’ve advocated to make the Farm Bill work for Pennsylvania, giving farmers the help they need and ensuring that our agriculture industry can continue to thrive.
My opponent, on the other hand, is out of step with folks from these communities. He’s a multi-millionaire who made his money on Wall Street and lives in a mansion on Connecticut’s “Gold Coast.” He doesn’t understand the needs of our farmers and folks in rural areas — and only cares about the billionaires funding his campaign.
I believe where you live shouldn’t determine the quality of your education, access to health care, or ability to obtain a family-sustaining job. The contrast between me and my opponent on this issue could not be more clear.

Look, here’s something that needs to be said:
No Democrat would ever inspire a violent attack on the United States Capitol to overturn the peaceful transfer of power.
Why? Because Democrats believe in democracy.
If you know me, you know I’m an optimist. I truly believe that not just Democrats but the vast majority of Americans believe in our founding ideals, trust our democratic systems, and want to preserve free and fair elections.
But Donald Trump and far too many of his followers (including my self-described ‘MAGA’ opponent) have made it clear that they don’t. We’re facing extraordinary circumstances that require each and every one of us to commit to this fight — not stand by idly and hope it all turns out well.
What we do in November — less than two months from now — will have a lasting impact on our nation. We can either band together and stand up against the forces that seek to tear down our democracy, or we can sit around and let them win.
Today, I’m asking you to take action to protect our democracy by making a donation to my re-election campaign. Your support will go directly towards sending me back to the Senate and holding our Democratic majority — something we absolutely must do if we have any hope of securing democracy for generations to come. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Our next chapter is not yet written, but what we choose to do this November will determine the future of our nation — so thank you for standing with me on this critical issue.
-Tim Kaine

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
Joining Chairman Whatley at the Protect the Vote rally in Elkhorn, my work to secure our elections this November, and looking ahead to this weekend. | | | | |
---
| 50 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
**Protect the Vote Rally** I was glad to welcome RNC Chairman Whatley and former Florida Attorney General Pam Bondi to Elkhorn to talk about what we’re doing to ensure we have secure elections.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| If you want to help us protect the vote this November, click the link below and join the Wisconsin Election Integrity team.
---
[Click Here to Join the Wisconsin Election Integrity Team](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=7113e46d7f&e=e907534017)
| **Working to Secure Our Elections** Last week, I held a hearing with six secretaries of state to review the status of States’ election preparedness.
As the Chairman of the Committee on House Administration, I’ve worked to pass comprehensive election integrity legislation, conduct critical oversight of states’ election administration, and ensure states have the tools they need to keep our elections secure.
* We’ve passed the SAVE Act.
* We’ve uncovered the influence private and foreign funding has in our elections.
* Last week, we rolled out the House Election Observer Program to ensure our elections are run fairly and accurately.

---
[Click Here to Hear More! ](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=dc3722fde5&e=e907534017)
| **Help us Knock Doors in Beloit** On Saturday, our team will be knocking doors in Beloit. We’re always looking for more volunteers to help us knock doors and get the word out.
---
| Interested in joining us? Reach out at **bryan@steilforwisconsin.com** and we’ll provide you with more details!
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

name: Kevin Faulconer
subject: NEWS: Kevin Faulconer Wins Debate, Exposes Terra Lawson-Remer’s Failure to Address Homeless Crisis And Work Absenteeism
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Faulconer for Supervisor 2024 - FPPC ID 1461674**
body:
NEWS: Kevin Faulconer Wins Debate, Exposes Terra Lawson-Remer’s Failure to Address Homeless Crisis And Work Absenteeism | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/9083756b999c/news-kevin-faulconer-wins-debate-exposes-terra-lawson-remers-failure-to-address-homeless-crisis-and-work-absenteeism?e=784f78234b)
---
| |
---
| | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
September 16, 2024

Contact: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Kevin Faulconer Wins Debate, Exposes Terra Lawson-Remer’s Failure to Address Homeless Crisis And Work Absenteeism**
Carlsbad, CA — Kevin Faulconer, former Mayor of San Diego and candidate for County Supervisor, claimed a decisive victory at tonight’s debate hosted by the Carlsbad,Encinitas, and Solana Beach Chambers of Commerce. Faulconer underscored his clear vision for solving the county’s homelessness crisis while his opponent, incumbent Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer, failed to provide answers or defend her no-show record to the homeless task force she’s supposed to lead.
---
| During the debate, Faulconer criticized Lawson-Remer for her absence on the critical issue of homelessness, which has worsened every year she’s been in office.
**“We’re in the midst of the worst homelessness crisis, with people dying on our streets every day and the only thing missing more than solutions from Terra Lawson-Remer is her attendance at work. San Diego County deserves a leader who shows up, works with everyone for everyone, and delivers real solutions,” Faulconer said. “Tonight’s debate showed that Supervisor Lawson-Remer is out of touch and checked out.”**
_Faulconer highlighted a shocking statistic:_ Lawson-Remer has missed more Board of Supervisors meetings than all of her colleagues combined. Despite making $280,000 a year, Lawson-Remer could not answer why she has consistently skipped meetings and votes. Throughout the debate, Lawson-Remer struggled to explain her poor performance, from missing nearly half of all meetings to failing to show up for critical discussions on the countywide homeless task force—a task force she is vice chair of.
Faulconer pressed her on these absences, pointing out that such negligence has contributed to the worsening state of the region’s homelessness crisis.
Faulconer ended the debate by reiterating his commitment to being the hands-on bipartisan leader the county desperately needs. He vowed to address the homelessness crisis head-on, prioritize public safety, and restore accountability to the Board of Supervisors. ###
For more information about Faulconer’s campaign, visit [www.kevinfaulconer.com](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=80a238f17c&e=784f78234b).

name: Senator Deb Fischer
subject: One thing hasn’t changed
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
I hope I can count on your support.

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9g5lnmpaebq9qe1g66o7ott272gmk931s1o4th8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)

Friend,

The last several months have given us some of the most memorable events in American campaign history -- can you believe it's only been a few months since the fateful Atlanta Presidential Debate between **[President Trump](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zd20tcobt7ohrebu0oi35b2l768cnqslkkupnq5o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)** and Joe Biden?

Then came President Trump's survival of a deadly assassination attempt in Pennsylvania and his nomination, along with my conservative GOP Senate colleague from Ohio, running mate **[J.D. Vance,](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zblt6bfla9iq6pl9dre35blu2s8tp9965fsm7lp8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)** Joe Biden's withdrawal from the race, the Democrats' coronation of radical Kamala Harris and her selection of leftist Minnesota Governor Tim Walz.

But with all of this change, _one thing hasn 't:_ I'm counting on you, no matter what happens in these final, pivotal weeks of the campaign, **[to stand with me and win this decisive Nebraska U.S. Senate race.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z44pnknr5612qq3f97mukj8838l0v530impg38co_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)**

The disastrous leftist agenda of the **[Biden-Harris Democrats](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zn9vjsjrl2na9pgkslpes3uorvhdmt9t5o5m0o80_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)** must be stopped -- and reversed. That opportunity is rapidly approaching with the 2024 Elections, friend, **[and that's why I'm contacting you today.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zn6nltp5uoma940a03j5d5hn3beumk7mmjdbnsfo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)**

Just like they counted on Kamala Harris' vote as President of the Senate to break dozens of ties in their favor, the Democrats are desperate to keep their control over the Majority to continue their dangerous agenda and avoid accountability for their failures and abuse of power.

To end their schemes -- and begin repairing the damage they've inflicted with commonsense conservative solutions -- we need strong Republican Senators who will follow through with the experience and capability necessary to get things done on Capitol Hill.

We must stay focused on a successful outcome by ensuring we're as prepared as we can be, **[and that starts with supporters like you.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpce08b2v8pa61cd2hkipo74mo3ge70oa5ltcbpg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)**

That's why I hope I can count on you **[to step up and make a generous contribution to my 2024 Nebraska U.S. Senate re-election effort immediately!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zr334g54ld254hnvp4o3vmn2cip82h3qvt1icnvo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)**

_Thank you,_ friend.

Best,

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z11ga6fremgd524g1n1mh6qf86h4j5885hs50psg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)
Deb Fischer

**[Chip in TODAY!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrgg443tvcqn9at20siak2mijo1q8o10ksuqejh8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhm6pj1cph2bs)**

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund
subject: Kamala Quiz: Do You Really Know Her (hint: You Don’t)
body:
The election is getting closer, and there is a lot to do, but we like to have some fun too
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **************** As we get closer to the November election, the mainstream media has doubled down on its efforts to protect Kamala Harris, as we saw most recently with the ABC debate. That is why it is vital that you know the truth and share that truth with others.
Because we want to help you stay informed and have fun at the same time, we created a fun activity that you can do with friends and family called the [Kamala Quiz](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a50d8b4b/1edb9794a50cb0bf "Kamala Quiz"). This quiz will test your knowledge about the Vice President of the United States and tell you who she really is - and you'll have fun discovering who **_not_** to vote for. __******** **__****__**
---
| | [ TAKE THE QUIZ ](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a50d8b4b/1edb9794a50cb0c1)
---
| **************** But that's not all. We have also created our 8-Week Plan to help you influence and educate undecided voters in your immediate sphere of influence. This plan tackles a new hot topic every week and gives you the resources you need to tell people about it.

**8-Week Plan topics:**
1. Kamala Quiz: America in Jeopardy
2. Only Citizens Vote
3. Stop Big Government Socialism
4. Let Parents Be Parents
5. Kamala Makes Us Unsafe
6. Grow The Economy, Stop Inflation
7. Border Security
8. Kamala Quiz: America in Jeopardy
This week we are focusing on Only Citizens Vote, and [onlycitizensvotecoalition.com](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a50d8b4b/1edb9794a50cb0c3 "onlycitizensvotecoalition.com") provides you with some great toolkits that can help you in whatever weekly activity works best for you.
* **Sunday:** Plan your week: Goal is to meet with your team and make a plan #plantowin.
* **Monday:** Write letters to editors and social media posts about the weekly issue.
* **Tuesday:** Phone banking and relational outreach #takeactiontuesday.
* **Wednesday:** Write those postcards! (Request yours at [marchtovictory.com](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a50d8b4b/1edb9794a50cb0c5 "marchtovictory.com"))
* **Thursday:** House Party: invite your friends and family to become familiar with the weekly issue.
* **Friday:** Organize a sign-waving event: tell the residents where you live about the weekly issue.
* **Saturday:** Attend a door knocking event of your choice with one of our many partners.
And before we wrap this up, we want to remind you that Tuesday is [Constitution Day](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a50d8b4b/1edb9794a50cb0c7 "https://www.constitutionday.com/") where we celebrate the ratification of our governing documents and the reason we fight so hard to keep our republic. Without the United States Constitution, we wouldn't have the freedom we've enjoyed since the founding of this country - and that's worth celebrating.
Thank you for your dedication to our nation! We couldn't do any of this without you. __******** **__****__**
---
| ******** In liberty,

Jenny Beth **__****__**

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdugbblfoubolji36ten6ph9imse7g1v952s2nno_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clhmeoj6c9h2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

body:
New Jersey and the United States Senate need Curtis Bashaw.

Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state. And I love this country.

I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him,**[join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate. >>](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/j37a8GM0_viPEtkxmu-8Ug~~/AARclAA~/RgRoy8G--lmi89zzVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn't always easy but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me. After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so called "community" was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: Hatred and Racism. Pathetic.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore. We can look to him to promote prosperity for all--a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States.

There comes a time when we have to speak out in support of our nation's traditional values. For Patriotism. For the right to pursue happiness on our own terms.

We need a remedy for what Washington has been doing.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy, or at least a good part of it.

**[Please, join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.>>](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/j37a8GM0_viPEtkxmu-8Ug~~/AARclAA~/RgRoy8G--lmi89zzVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

The 2024 General Election is scheduled to be held seven weeks from today on Tuesday, November 5, 2024.

United Sovereign Americans has filed federal lawsuits in nine states (https://d56tDQ04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UD+113/d56tDQ04/MW0SFn_shZsN57ncHJ5wRQqW1MKd8X5l3Q3lN63y6n63lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3q3W8kQFQL865g18V4vQGs8K0HRNW56t0XV8DTVXtW8B780T23dkX7N89kyWxM8VCpMTNjNhfcDjyW6ZNWkL4wH_qXW3XYW1w4fdR88VKNpTX7Lf9kfW4PjFXW8wGDYwW4fRSXt20BY6sW2Nll668VCg17W3ngBGf4b5BQ2N3pBwwVsv-y0W3cKPDZ8gbxqrW3f9z3P7wK5xmW8RqbBF6t3kJFW4H3X-b1GpSSWW52z5v61j_H99W28Pw148xlB77W54qb_r38h7jxW8X2ShS5LHc2jdpB91g04 ) , which are designed to protect our fundamental right to vote, as outlined in the United States Constitution.

These substantially equivalent lawsuits demand that courts review our evidence from the 2022 General Election, and force election officials to comply with the law in the 2024 General Election by addressing the voter registration issues we identified.

By design, the geography of these suits creates jurisdiction within different federal circuit courts. If any of the circuit court decisions split between “Yes” and “No,” then the substantially equivalent arguments of all nine lawsuits move the questions to the US Supreme Court for a decision. This is the only way under the United States Constitution to resolve the dispute in law.

Across these nine states, official records show more than 3.3 million more ballots in error than legally allowed by federal statute. This amounts to a vote error rate of 20% in Pennsylvania, 14% in Ohio, and 14% in North Carolina, compared to the maximum 0.0008% error rate set by Congress.

| Dear Friend, This is the rare email from a political candidate that doesn't ask you to give anything. I'm running for Congress because Texas -- really, all Americans-- need strong, pragmatic voices in Congress. My opponent is an eleven-time incumbent(!!) who hasn't done anything to change the status quo and doesn't even seem that concerned about it. The last thing we need right now is just more of the same -- career politicians who are struggling to keep up but refuse to step down, who've promised everything and delivered nothing. We all know this last Congress was one of the least productive in our nation's history.
The status quo just isn't working for working families.
That's the reason behind what I've been telling folks when I'm out meeting with voters: our district is ready for a new day.
I want to earn your support in this race, so I want to hear from you. I'm here to serve you and your families -- not the other way around.
I know, I know; that's unusual for a candidate. But this campaign is all about making a change for the better. That change starts with listening to what Texans like you really care about, what your family really needs, and what Congress hasn't been doing for them.
Folks, I think our current political situation has a real simple solution. Congress simply has to go back to working FOR us, rather than ON us.
If you have a moment, please reply to this email and let me know the top three issues you think Congress really needs to address, but hasn't. The last thing we need right now is just more of the same -- career politicians who are struggling to keep up but refuse to step down, who've promised everything and delivered nothing. We all know this last Congress was one of the least productive in our nation's history. The status quo just isn't working for working families. That's the reason behind what I've been telling folks when I'm out meeting with voters: our district is ready for a new day. I want to earn your support in this race, so I want to hear from you. I'm here to serve you and your families -- not the other way around. I know, I know; that's unusual for a candidate. But this campaign is all about making a change for the better. That change starts with listening to what Texans like you really care about, what your family really needs, and what Congress hasn't been doing for them. Folks, I think our current political situation has a real simple solution. Congress simply has to go back to working FOR us, rather than ON us. If you have a moment, please reply to this email and let me know the top three issues you think Congress really needs to address, but hasn't. == | | == | It's time for the issues that matter outside the Beltway to matter inside it. subject: Never eat almonds, spinach and peanut butter (Here's why)
body:
Untitled Document

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

If you've been led to believe
that peanut butter, almonds and spinach are good for you, today's
email might shock you and is important to read, because these 3
healthy foods could be contributing to health problems in your
body.

Let's take a quick look at why...

1. Peanut butter

While peanut butter does contain
a small amount of protein and vitamins/minerals, the cons
outweigh the pros on this food.

First of all, peanuts contain one
of the highest concentrations of aflatoxin, which is a mold toxin
that is created in peanuts due to storage in moist conditions.

Peanut butter is also very high
in inflammatory omega-6 fats and due to the processing of peanut
butter, those omega 6 fats are in a harmful oxidized state.

Most people already get too much
omega 6 fats from vegetable oils (soy, corn, canola, etc), and
this contributes to insulin resistance, heart disease, brain
inflammation, cancer, and lots more health problems, since most
people are currently eating 5-10x more omega-6 fats than we
should be eating in a healthy diet.

Lastly, peanut butter also
contains medium amounts of oxalates, which are plant-based
antinutrients that when consumed in excess can contribute to
kidney stones, thyroid and gut problems, joint problems and more.

We'll talk more about oxalates in
the next food...

2. Spinach

Spinach is promoted as a healthy
green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides. Spinach
is one of the highest oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by
modern humans (in addition to beet greens, beets, almonds, and
other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a
serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal
sized bowl.

The "safe" amount of oxalates in
a daily diet according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally
Norton should be between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot
of the health problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So, you can see how concerning
spinach is with the extremely high oxalate levels.

As mentioned above, eating too
much oxalates too frequently can cause serious issues such as
kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and
joint pain.

In fact, some people have even
gotten "oxalate poisoning" by eating green smoothies too often
and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

3. Almonds

Although almonds and almond milk
are marketed as healthy, they also contain many downsides,
including all of the negatives mentioned above about too much
omega 6 fats and too much oxalates.

They're probably ok in your diet
occasionally, but I personally avoid eating almonds too often
because of these issues with excess oxalates and omega 6 fats.

Now let's take a look at a fun
little quiz below and a few more foods...

Bananas vs oranges vs apples...
(the #1 WORST fruit for your gut & energy)
According to the best-selling
author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry,
there's one fruit people over 40 should never eat.

This fruit can damage your gut
and disrupt your hormones. Both sapping you of energy and forcing
your body to create "sticky" fat cells that can NOT be "burned
off" with normal diet and exercise.

Do you know the fruit I'm talking
about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it
is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

>> Bananas

>> Oranges

>> Apples

>> Grapes

name: Jameson Ellis
subject: You're not alone Peter
body:
United we stand

**Peter,**

Have you ever felt like you're the only one standing up for what's right?

The only one willing to speak the truth, even when the world around you seems to crumble into chaos?

Back in 2020, many of us felt that way. It was a year marked by division, riots, and fear. The media bombarded us with narratives designed to isolate and silence those who dared to stand for freedom, faith, and truth.

We felt

**alone**, like we were the minority in a country we believed stood for liberty.

And then... the 2020 election happened.

The sense of loss for many was profound - not just a loss of confidence in the system, but personal losses. We lost family members, friends, and even communities that once stood together.

Many of us were left wondering:

**"Am I the only one who sees what's happening?"**

But here's the truth -

**you** are

**not alone**.

There are millions of patriots just like you, who refuse to compromise their values, who continue to stand strong for the truth. You may not see us on the news or hear our voices in the media, but we're here.

And on

**September 28th**, at

**Texas MAGA Fest**, we will stand together once again.

**Texas MAGA Fest: We Are The Trump Card** is more than an event-it's a homecoming. A place where you can look around and know, without a doubt, that you are part of a much larger community. A community that refuses to be silenced, that still believes in

**America** and its founding principles.

After the second attempt on President Trump's life, the time for complacency is over. He needs us now more than ever. And we need each other.

September 28th has been declared

**MAGA Day**, a day for patriots to rise up and stand in the gap for our country. This is our chance to show the world that

**we are the majority**, that

**we are the Trump card**, and that the spirit of this country remains

****unbroken****.

Don't let this opportunity pass you by.

**Join us** at Texas MAGA Fest, stand side by side with your fellow patriots, and be part of the movement that will shape the future.

Your voice matters.

**Your presence matters.**

**Get your $10 ticket today** and join us in standing for our country: https://jamesonellis.acemlna.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE4UqLMDKF8yQxMUeBt2H6kk_Ugle02XHXLUneg7pN__ky.zeJz242jiNg~j_YxY5TG https://jamesonellis.acemlna.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE4UqLMDKF8yQxMUeBt2H6kk_Ugle02XHXLUneg7pN__ky.zeJz242jiNg~j_YxY5TG

**For Liberty,**

Sent to: dpwillis67@gmail.com

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6e733bd369194192ac1eef7b210a0b24&_e=4_SE6c78odStAkF87dOG1_jZmf0bRJATPZYFB1G8RCoefUWzulEfNvsGiTO9mw__09IWOdIGPHEolDRBdGnbpkivUiiaATsGp7UymjmF6_OxSb2wWFoqGMZ_tI78Ji8PBi25UMLBDfX76TRdNjyO7z8UmgWrCcS3VivHK9eMCisXeAh0UsdNYqj4nu7TXeqewabIhn0kId0ulUk3FOqFlS1ZZ9GIB3AfxJNxuxWDy03tXcHWJ-h7bGilZmeMQUFFdVZOTxwZv5K2N4DET2tAKN5foJPvo-7xQ5YiqUE9qjjGBJ56lVhffJVZuWYfXuAxgXnqs4pVnN6u2oG1EuBtWw9ipzXoCE_-jRc38FA5evDXGMOYMkQjJXDorMwB3boyypxASyjmy4L-w9gv-SEC-QrIHSHB1svlS57Sr3x-loM%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6e733bd369194192ac1eef7b210a0b24&_e=4_SE6c78odStAkF87dOG1_jZmf0bRJATPZYFB1G8RCoefUWzulEfNvsGiTO9mw__09IWOdIGPHEolDRBdGnbpkivUiiaATsGp7UymjmF6_OxSb2wWFoqGMZ_tI78Ji8PBi25UMLBDfX76TRdNjyO7z8UmgWrCcS3VivHK9eMCisXeAh0UsdNYqj4nu7TXeqewabIhn0kId0ulUk3FOqFlS1ZZ9GIB3AfxJNxuxWDy03tXcHWJ-h7bGilZmeMQUFFdVZOTxwZv5K2N4DET2tAKP7xvN8L6BYV8vk7Zo2d5TtU2yDFlELFOpigYZSFEw6XnQRFusapf9Ee6izEgWwqDHMQYiziZjf3tAXThSpVCHyAa5S-Z7tdLvHURAluUOW5TAOIFl84rQN5kuk0UPB-FpTfEic8vuT4Uo8GlP_PD8Q%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. ## Massive Pipeline Fire Erupts Near Houston
A 20-inch natural gas pipeline was damaged in the Houston suburb of La Porte Monday morning, igniting a [massive pillar of fire](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vgzAUAH-N2Yyen7_w4KELW7p2RAY_ghUTkHEh_fdVunc-nXS6r9twCymn5_0zrOTra96GMNV00uC4sBzVoJroR4hONOSFRaOt1gKbxcdOTc6YEayx0pkAnSDh1OScjHKO2CSPgAqcsAK0kbYVo1HBOjHP0I3SEFNAMdWttHWhSq9wzPlnO6m007Y22S-17geTHwx7hv11Xe1j2b7fkGEfSk1TJob9k66DYZ-3KWSGfSQqfA_lwdMa7nTwM0Xa-J52yulJfE7lbWGnOWjbIYSJQ7TIlYqOj6OWXAOICE5JcLYpPu5XyjkdxjIF9zWk_BdY__l1evwNAAD__0agaX8) that prompted officials to evacuate nearby neighborhoods. Initial reports indicate the fire started when a car hit one of the pipeline's valves. Energy Transfer, the pipeline operator, [cut off the flow of natural gas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00D2O6yAUQOHV4A4LCD9xQfEad3ntlNY1XGIkAhZgO9n9aKaf_hRH39djeUBMMT__wwttf4eygOvxxGWi3FAhFzl4uzI_8QEtN0IroxQXw2ZXUDw4Hybmg7oH79Ex7aSatBb3wPkQrWBCsokbzpS-mZGvWoKZeAjsvt40EsnQx17q2Dfs-IYW0qecWEdXXkOyW-97I7d_RMxEzNd1jaG8hd7K0XrJPxERc8arETEnoHupHeked0wxIw2xIs0IlbYds8NKt_jcLvhQB0fDRmsBT10q7ajYKJ7gDuix5DZU6_crphSbNkSy5wti-n3qfxCdVnwHAAD__xX9bVg) to the site but said the fire would continue until the current supply is depleted. Several homes in the vicinity of the fire [sustained structural damage](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2PhCAUAH8Ndhi-hLWguMZur73SPOW5vgSBCFl3__1lr79uiikm83Of70CR0uMbDvTtteUZ1kZPnEcuHVdmNl3wiwij7NBLp-zghkGqbvdLGJW-Ba2dA1QG9SqGsBgTFgkogu3IK6GMGKWTYrDa9XKxBtwot03cFm2RGYGBWj77tmPDF9QtvvMTz37NRxf93lqpTH8xNTE1XdfVH-8KCVLLifJHYmpKeFWmJjgbrRE_xAsVjJSQ71A5vkrMAQOHFDhVnhPf6EROiQOXo7M3q1xf9tKdPpSLYqRqHTPicQDFv5L2z5inV78BAAD__84YZm4). Energy Transfer is establishing a claims process for those who experienced property loss from the fire. Governor Abbott deployed state resources to assist with the response, and officials are monitoring the air quality in the area.
## Abbott Launches Operation Targeting Venezuela Gangs
Governor Greg Abbott announced the creation of a new database aimed at identifying [potential threats from Venezuelan illegal immigrants](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OqzAQxfGnMR3IM_6YS-HiNnTZdktkmCFYMiFrvCH79quk3_53dKT_52W8xJTT7foRNwn1uexjnGt6yNi3QC3a0TYcJs09NBKA0DtyDrBZwyTGkfM2ijhgQ8LgjUfoWc86smlSQI1W90CgnTfUweRtpB6WRf-bjBdltXCqe-nqKlWe8Vjyz_6Q0s371uSw1no_lPmvcFA4nOf5crPcqpTj6zsWeTmFw3uqcIilpjnLyMYQ-2VuyXpoAWRpJ2NtyxQFfI8s1nRr3XJTAt_PlHM6PCmrr1tM-X1e_2jxCPgbAAD__7uYX9A). During a Monday press conference in Houston, Abbott said more than 3,000 illegal immigrants from Venezuela have been arrested in Texas since 2021, including more than 100 of those arrested for [rioting at the El Paso border](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGu4yAQheGnwd1EMGAIBcU2dHfbLSMcjzGSbSwYJ_e-_Srbb32kT0f_n6_HVypbOfLvtFPg76U-0pPLix4elAM0DzPMYZKzVwMF5dCObhwVDmvQXo_kktXSe3s3OKK3qJ8krbbG3-9DCSjRSK-ckqPV7qYma5LzalnkfdKWhJE0F67txisxfae-bD_1Re32rPuwhZX57EL_EhgFxuPnrJ0_k8D4kQVG6QVGZQXGq8NB7y4w9quf9GSagRsdMBOklvKVIKcjT-nI1Dq8qRGcqTHUBXgl2Etu6WDIrV4n8JoY2tXXj7ISTLXN1ATGoYX5fJdtK906YWTeU9n-3eX_1HsF_BsAAP__EytxrA) earlier this year. The effort is aimed particularly at illegal migrants affiliated with the violent Tren de Aragua (TDA) gang, which Abbot declared a foreign terrorist organization. Last week, 20 suspected TDA members were arrested after the [Gateway Hotel in El Paso was shut down](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAUhJ8Gd1hwjCEUFLehy223tPg5dpAwRDaxs_v0q7jfdmY0M_q-7tPdpZzK8t-taNp7rpMLLR04acoVBTGJLhrPouYdGq5AjmocOXQPw4IbvLwxDIwLFmIcxlvQTA8jk0Jp3yUDDATTXHE2ykH13EvhlObzzG5-kEgEw5ha3fr2wIZvt8_5ux649aGuXTaP1p47Gf4RsATseZ59wXMvrqVaSj0_KQL2tdOPTMCmdU3LdtkErK9bxI2GT6FbkIB13tfW6LVEDyz488LsCl1cWQjYbjPxeaac0y4VEWxZXcrXlfYHmcPAbwAAAP__MjRoNw) by the county.
## 48,000 Bees Removed From TV Anchor's Home
Houston-based TV anchor Shern-Min Chow discovered an unexpected roommate situation: [roughly 48,000 bees](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGupCAUgOGnwQ5zOAJHCopt7GbbLQ3gcSSLOhEyzr795t7-1n_z5_vzmB8hl3w8f4edffus5xxSy2-enVQkUc-6W3yExamOvSK0hoxR2G1-jYaCowGiGx2kYDhZppHtGBCdHrrsEVCDU6TA2IF6Fa0O5NS6whgHy0IDL7mdV982bvwJdS3_zjdffTr3rvittVcVwy-Bk8Dpvu_-Lx_VfFWBU7haToUFTgffVeBUzhSKwCkyV1k3vg6550Om7bwFTjgaCYAEQChTiE5qdiAjMcplWbWxjGgTdZdfXncuJVdLQsNzD7l8D7UffN4e_wcAAP__vvFkVw) living rent-free in her garage wall. Bee expert Mark Lockhart performed a careful eviction, relocating the buzzing tenants to his own property. Chow documented the un-bee-lievable process, from thermal imaging to hive extraction. [Watch a video here](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j71ugzAYAJ_G3oL8hw2Dh0oRG63aJWoXZOPPYMnUEXyB5O2rdM96J510l37oXcrpd3p3C1i8xzK4EdMOQ3vi5iTUoGiwnoWWU7DcCF2buuaCzlY1To4OwLecSS9qP4aoATSTsVG6CTRZwYRiLTec1VqainutnGl5jKzxUgNRDELCslY4A8LdbTE_yg5rNZaFZjsjXjci34joiOiO46ge5YY3D0__JA7HmchuJ_I8_cDlq5w_-s9vutpwPVLOadOGKDYtLuX_JL443K34CwAA__-DfFNU).

Few know that those shingles could be sustainably recycled into oil, construction materials, and other valuable goods - which amounts to a potential **$4.4B in market**. **Sky Quarry** has patented the technology to do that. They're planning a **Nasdaq listing under 'SKYQ'**, but [investors can invest now before their current offering ends tomorrow](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx80LGO4yAUheGnwV0i7sVAKChWitJl2y0tbK5ttGB7AXuTtx95iulm6vM1__nz7J4uxLBMv10iW1_j2rmhhoM6cwF9wbZrG2977g00ZEGjklpKwGa2ShPXxsANBaIctIKBeI-cUy_kIHUTLHJsuQENXCqhr9Cr1mkD48hvvVDEWk4-1DVf60yVXq6M8b0elK_Dmppo51o3Jn4xfDB8hOWgctry9_1vdzm_T3Vu4rHX1JV1zwMxcfcpf5HoFh-WaXMTMVQnS-TDnpi4by7XhXKZwwY3fhESOn42M1R1cYnKD6YDBUajUUbpJlu__Q8xhqI0a_mUXIifAfWbPw-LHwEAAP__4Ed2zg). The company has already generated**$50M in revenue** at their Foreland Refinery in Nevada. And they're opening another location in the next year, the PR Spring facility, with plans to produce **up to 1,000,000 barrels of oil annually. ** We believe that Sky Quarry is doing something potentially [revolutionary](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx80LGO4yAUheGnwV0i7sVAKChWitJl2y0tbK5ttGB7AXuTtx95iulm6vM1__nz7J4uxLBMv10iW1_j2rmhhoM6cwF9wbZrG2977g00ZEGjklpKwGa2ShPXxsANBaIctIKBeI-cUy_kIHUTLHJsuQENXCqhr9Cr1mkD48hvvVDEWk4-1DVf60yVXq6M8b0elK_Dmppo51o3Jn4xfDB8hOWgctry9_1vdzm_T3Vu4rHX1JV1zwMxcfcpf5HoFh-WaXMTMVQnS-TDnpi4by7XhXKZwwY3fhESOn42M1R1cYnKD6YDBUajUUbpJlu__Q8xhqI0a_mUXIifAfWbPw-LHwEAAP__4Ed2zg). Here's a list of the different markets they can address by recycling discarded asphalt shingles alone:
* **Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAFs):** Airlines looking to reduce their carbon footprint will push this market from $1B to $16.8B by 2030 - a _1,500% increase_.
* **Sustainable Construction Materials:** The market for green building materials is projected to reach $125B by 2033.
* **New Asphalt Roofing Shingles:** Asphalt shingle sales are two-thirds of the roofing market, with demand projected to reach $197B by 2032.
* **Carbon Credits:** The carbon credit market is projected to reach $25B by 2030.

This is a paid advertisement for Sky Quarry's Regulation A Offering. name: Debbie for Florida
subject: Are you SURE you're registered to vote?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
Important Information re: Voter Registration
| | |
---
Friends — voting isn't just a right;**** it's our civic duty.
**But this National Voter Registration Day, I'm acutely aware of the barriers that anti-democracy Republicans have put in place to keep us from fulfilling that duty:**
* **Purging** thousands of voters — _especially voters of color_ — from the rolls

* **Reducing ballot drop box** numbers and accessibility

* Introducing more **stringent voter ID** requirements, including proof of U.S. citizenship

* Establishing drastically higher requirements and **criminal penalties for third-party Get Out The Vote organizations**

Thanks to the anti-democratic agenda they've enacted, Florida has the **fifth-lowest rate** of registered eligible voters nationwide.
It gets worse: After voters supported a 2018 ballot initiative to restore voting rights to over one million Floridians with felony records, the legislature passed a law requiring them to pay all fees and fines related to their case in order to regain eligibility, or face _further criminal prosecution_ if they vote mistakenly.

**This effectively disenfranchised about 800,000 people, disproportionately Black Floridians, who otherwise could have made their voices heard.**
Laws like these, and our severely gerrymandered map, mean that Ron DeSantis and his far-right legislative supermajority don't even have to hide their ultimate intention:**suppressing voters to consolidate their power.**
So in a race this close, ahead of a historic election that will decide Senate control _and_ the future direction of our state and our country, I have to ask:
**Are you registered to vote? _Are you sure?_ **
If so, I _strongly_ _recommend_ you verify your registration [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92963684/498916654/-1263008137?refcode=jtk1911-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWZjZDFmYzEtZTY3NC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=a4b0aJB3eKtHOdGaz3tsyv91rJXWQMD1RehMgul8IKk=&emci=8dbea833-5174-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=1fcd1fc1-e674-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=3969733), and do so on a yearly basis.** ** And if you're a Florida resident that hasn't registered yet, you have until **Monday, Oct. 7** to change that.
To register to vote in Florida,**you must be a U.S. citizen with Florida residence, at least 18 years of age**(but 16-year-olds _can_ pre-register)**, and have a reliable mailing address. **The application process can be done:

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWKPREiWNq

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWKPREiWNq

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

Are you
enjoying your Imprimis subscription?

Do you
look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most
interesting conservatives each month?

I hope
so.

You will
never have to pay for Imprimis because we want its message in
defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many
citizens as possible.

We're
grateful that you read Imprimis, and we hope you share your copy
with others after you've read it-and that you encourage others
you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale
relies on a nationwide network of supporters-people like you-to
help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government,
free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and
strong national defense.

You're a
longtime Imprimis subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how
the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our
country.

And you
understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to
undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate
the American people about our founding principles of
liberty…the importance of reviving limited constitutional
government…the need to defend the rule of law…and
the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free
enterprise.

That's
why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale
College.

Other
colleges and universities have fallen prey to moral and cultural
relativism and the oppression of "political
correctness"-Hillsdale has not-and it continues to fulfill its
mission of defending civil and religious liberty through
education.

Will you
help?

In
addition to sending Imprimis to more Americans, you will help
us…

Teach
Americans of all ages who wish to learn about the Declaration of
Independence, the Constitution, free-market economics, American
Heritage, the Great Books, and more through free online courses
(to date, more than 4 million students have registered for one or
more courses);

Launch and support dozens more classical K-12 schools
nationwide-schools where students receive an education rooted in
the liberal arts and sciences and learn the importance of moral
character and civic virtue. More than 15,000 students currently
attend over 90 Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools, and thousands
more are on waiting lists.

Your
support is especially needed today because Hillsdale College does
not accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in
the form of federal or state student grants and loans. We refuse
to allow the government to interfere with our internal affairs.

So, we
rely on the support of informed patriots like you, who understand
the importance of education to liberty.

Whatever
amount you give today, whether it's…

>> $25
>> $35
>> $50
>> $100
>> $250

…will help us defend the freedom of the American people
and the American way of life through education.

Simply
click the link below and let us know if we can count on your
support.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63561066:WKPREiWNq:m:3:2532013465:68D41F023716A1EC41F73355435AAB8D:r

Thank you
in advance for your help in reaching and teaching millions more
Americans on behalf of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dear
Friend,

Every
Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the
Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year,
I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions
like "Does God exist? Can we know God?" with my students.

These
questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in
our relationship with each other and with God.

Today, I
want to offer you that same experience by sending you a
limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course,
"Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke," as a
token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of
Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

I invite
you to study the history of the "big questions" with my
colleagues and me.

Hey - it's House Majority Leader Steve Scalise. In the past few weeks, I wouldn't be surprised if I racked up enough miles on the campaign trail to circle the globe!

I've been crisscrossing the country campaigning with our top GOP recruits in states like California, Nevada, Texas, and Colorado focused on three clear goals that will determine the future of our country:
_**[Goal #1:](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpg65bo5pctnjo6f6emaprohubi4blq9hdb327io_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clge9pr2c1h2bs "Goal #1:")**_ Holding the line in Biden-won districts represented by Republicans

House Democrats have $90+ million cash-on-hand and they're already using it to PUMMEL Conservatives in key battleground districts. And to make matters worse, Kamala Harris just cut a MASSIVE $10 million check to House Democrats.

_That is why we weren't surprised when Democrats surged ahead by 2 POINTS in the latest generic ballot poll..._

Look -

**When President Trump wins in November, he'll need a Conservative House Majority to pass his America First agenda through Congress. But if Democrats take control of the House, it'll be a disaster for our country.**

_**[So please, will you help save our Conservative House Majority for President Trump?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zi3go85u82elmpprei180jcg41ig9ra9nb8t8k20_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clge9pr2c1h2bs "So please, will you help me deliver a Republican House Majority to President Trump?")**_ **[**YES >>**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0rpbngiood1s01pskifekdcf9rmmnpb344r71lo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clge9pr2c1h2bs)_[**NO >>**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zho7hqm0f6uk8d160cdaa4jskub53g3m9bjdel88_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clge9pr2c1h2bs)**Friend - we need you to answer right here and now. There are less than 50 DAYS for us to band together and pull out a win in this election.

**If we decide to just kick back and let the Radical Democrats unleash everything they have against Conservatives, there 's a very real possibility we wake up on 11/06/2024 to a complete Liberal takeover of our country.**

I don't want that to happen.

And I don't think you want that either.

With your help, we can prevent that dark reality and save the House Majority while there's still time. _**[So I'm asking you to make a generous contribution to help elect Pro-Trump Conservatives nationwide and deliver a strong House Majority for President Trump.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6o4neokavrj2v5j0gr16ds29kl7gafkej1u50tg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3clge9pr2c1h2bs "So I’m asking you to make a generous contribution to help elect Pro-Trump Conservatives nationwide and deliver a strong House Majority for President Trump.")**_

Thank you for taking the time to read my entire message.

For America,
Steve Scalise

name: Drew MacEwen
subject: MacEwen campaign update
body:
Hello All,

Just a personal note from me.

We are putting the final pieces in place for the last push before ballots come out in just a few short weeks!

If you did not see - we recently did a poll that showed on an informed ballot we lead 46-45! This means if we have the resources to get our message out and contrast with my opponent we can win this district for the first time since 1962!

So, a quick check in on a few things:
1-if you are still waiting for a yard sign let me know via email along with your address. We are working hard to get the all out

2-I am aggressively raising money right now as we need to pay for almost all advertising by Oct 1. If you are willing to host a fundraiser or meet and greet please respond asap and let me know!

3- to the point above-we have a fundraiser Monday Sept 23 starting at 5 pm. Special guest Super Sonic and NBA Hall of Fame Jack Sikma will be joining! This will be at a private residence near the Kitsap county fairgrounds. If you would like to attend please reply and we will give you the address.

And finally, once ballots are out the biggest help we need is turning out the vote. If you are willing to make calls to people to remind them to vote let me know!

I appreciate your support!

\--

Kindest Regards,
Senator Drew MacEwen
Candidate for Congress (R) WA -06
[www.votedrewmac.com](http://www.votedrewmac.com)

We always knew the race to win Wisconsin was going to be neck and neck, but 1% is a truly razor thin margin.
#
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-sept24.SEeVOJ&refcode=em240913-1-c&t=1&akid=5386%2E196590%2E_-LzlV)
Friend — The latest Emerson poll out of Wisconsin shows Donald Trump **ahead** of Kamala Harris by just one point.
We always knew the race to win Wisconsin was going to be neck and neck, but 1% is a truly razor thin margin.
To put things in perspective, President Biden won Wisconsin in 2020 by a margin of only 0.63%. So when we see that Trump is ahead by 1% by less than 60 days, **we need to take that seriously.**
The good news is that The Long Run is working to raise hundreds of thousands of dollars for progressive candidates and turn out the vote here in Wisconsin.
Every down-ballot candidate we support helps drive more voters out to the polls on election day. Voters who will help us defeat Donald Trump, hold the Senate majority, and elect more change-makers to Congress and statehouses than ever before.
We can’t let Wisconsin be the state that hands victory to Trump and the far-right. Instead, we want Wisconsin to be the state that delivers a historic Kamala Harris presidency.
So please, we’re asking for your help in continuing to build on the momentum we’ve seen on the ground over the last two months.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Peter;
Today, September 17th, is National Voter Registration Day, I want to take this opportunity to encourage you to make a plan to vote in the upcoming election on November 5th, and ensure that your loved ones have a plan as well.
There are some convenient resources that make checking in on your registration status very simple:
*
You
can
go
to
this
webpage
[https://nationalvoterregistrationday.org/check-your-registration/]
to
ensure
that
your
voter
registration
is
up
to
date.
*
You
can
find
your
options
for
registering
to
vote
in
MA
(online,
in
person,
or
by
mail)
at
this
website.
[https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/voter-resources/registering-to-vote.htm]
*
Finally,
you
can
visit
the
Secretary
of
the
Commonwealth's
website
[https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/elections-and-voting.htm#how]
to
explore
different
options
for
voting
in
the
upcoming
election
and
decide
which
is
right
for
you.
Send those links around to your friends and family and encourage them to decide which method of voting is right for them- voting by mail, voting early in person, or voting in person on Election Day.
Voting is our civic duty, and I hope you’ll join me and make a plan to make your voice heard.
Onward,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Steve%20K%27s%20Signature.png]
Steve Kerrigan

body:
The Rocky Mountain Rumble Rallies Colorado Conservatives
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
We now have less than 50 days until the election! How are you getting involved? Check out my new project, the [Election Day Dash](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), for an easy way to make a huge difference over the next couple months. And don't forget to follow me on [X/Twitter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for lots of fun commentary on what's happening here in CO and across the U.S. LET'S WIN!

This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, September 17, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[The Rocky Mountain Rumble Rallies Colorado Conservatives](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
This past weekend in Sedalia, Colorado, hundreds of conservatives gathered as Wide Open Saloon hosted the very first Rocky Mountain Rumble, showcasing the strength and unity of the Colorado conservative community. As former President Donald Trump faced his second assassination attempt in two months just hours before the rally, it transformed into a powerful declaration of resolve in troubling times and a stark reminder of the divisions we face as a nation.
The rally featured prominent Colorado conservatives who addressed a range of pressing issues—from crime to economic concerns—highlighting the immediate need for active conservative participation in the upcoming elections.
Heidi Ganahl, founder of Rocky Mountain Voice, rallied the crowd speaking about her new conservative media source Rocky Mountain Voice, as well as a separate project, the Election Day Dash, that encourages voters to get their neighbors and friends involved. With just 50 days until the elections, Heidi’s call to action was clear: dedicate at least one hour daily to reclaim the direction of our country.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘I’m glad President Trump was OK’: Colorado Republicans react to second assassination attempt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Donald Trump survived a second assassination attempt while golfing at Mar-a-Lago in West Palm Beach, Florida. The shooter, armed with an SKS-style long gun, was positioned 400 yards away.
* Colorado Republicans, including Gabe Evans and Lauren Boebert, expressed support and relief after the incident. Boebert highlighted Trump's rising poll numbers as a reason for the attack.
* The Task Force on the Attempted Assassination of Donald J. Trump is investigating the incident and seeking updates from the U.S. Secret Service.
* Suspect Ryan Wesley Routh was arrested and faces charges that could result in a $500,000 fine and up to 20 years in prison.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[13 candidates running for Colorado legislative seats this year don’t have a major-party opponent](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Thirteen candidates are running unopposed for Colorado's state legislative seats in 2024, an increase from the previous election cycle.
* The candidates without major-party opponents include seven Democrats and three Republicans for the House, and three Democrats for the Senate.
* This phenomenon of uncontested races is attributed to the districts being strongholds for one party, either Democratic or Republican.
* Recent electoral strategies have focused on races with the highest potential for party gains, overlooking districts considered safe for the opposing party.
* The uncontested races reflect broader national trends of many legislative races across the U.S. going uncontested, raising concerns about democratic participation and representation.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Largest deportation’ in history to begin in Aurora, Springfield (Ohio), Trump says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Donald Trump announced plans for a major deportation initiative targeting Aurora, Colorado, and Springfield, Ohio, citing crime and immigration issues.
* The initiative is in response to the activities of a Venezuelan gang in Aurora and other immigration-related disturbances in Springfield.
* Aurora's response emphasized that immigration enforcement is a federal responsibility and reassured that local police focus on public safety without enforcing federal immigration laws.
* Aurora police have been active in addressing gang-related crimes, with several arrests made, though the city stresses that these issues are localized and not city-wide.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Mexican drug cartels are operating in southern Colorado, DEA agent says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [KDVR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The DEA reports that two major Mexican cartels, the Sinaloa and Jalisco (CJNG) Cartels, are actively operating in Southern Colorado, focusing on smuggling fentanyl into the U.S.
* The DEA employs a comprehensive strategy to dismantle these cartels by targeting their distribution networks, supply chains, and financial operations simultaneously.
* Significant actions include "Operation Cash Out," aiming to disrupt cartel finances across Colorado and neighboring states, and "Operation Last Mile," which focuses on the U.S. distribution networks linked to these cartels.
* The operations have resulted in thousands of arrests, massive drug seizures, and the confiscation of millions of dollars and numerous firearms.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fed-up suburbs plan to sue Denver after sanctuary city welcomes 42,000 migrants, including Tren de Aragua Gang](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver suburbs, including Castle Rock and Parker, are exploring lawsuits against Denver and Colorado, attributing local strains and increased crime to policies that welcomed 42,000 migrants, alongside the violent Venezuelan gang, Tren de Aragua.
* These suburbs aim to reverse sanctuary city policies that they believe have exacerbated public safety concerns.
* In areas like Aurora, law enforcement has noted significant criminal activities by Tren de Aragua, including drug trafficking and jewelry heists.
* Douglas County is part of a coalition suing the state over laws that limit local cooperation with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), challenging restrictions on detaining individuals based on immigration status and the use of local jails by ICE.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Matveyuk: Will our children live the American dream?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SERGEI MATVEYUK, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The days my children were born are among the best of my life. Like most parents, I want my children to live productive lives, be self-sufficient and pursue what makes them happy. Forty years ago, these simple hopes seemed impossible._
_I grew up in a Marxist country where hope was nearly nonexistent. My grandfather’s farm, flour mill and last cow were taken by the government. My grandmother and her four small children were left to die. Thankfully they survived but all they could do was survive. Their hope was to leave the Marxist country where people were persecuted for having faith in anything but the government. My father was sent to the gulag and my uncle was killed because of their faith and refusal to believe that the government would take care of them._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Costello: The unintended consequences of Proposition 127](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MIKE COSTELLO, [WESTWORD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Coloradans, I’m writing to you from California, where mountain lion hunting is illegal because of ballot-box biology. The idea of saving mountain lions and bobcats feels noble. They are magnificent critters, and supremely effective at making a living on the landscape (killing prey). We all love wild landscapes filled with diverse wildlife, including elusive and sometimes scary apex predators. While revered and respected for millennia, it is also true that humans have hunted, harvested and managed these animals as part of our own participation in the natural world._
_I call upon you: Do NOT abandon what works for wildlife in your great state. Ecosystems are incredibly complex, while Proposition 127 is a blunt-force solution for a problem that does not exist._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[MacKinnon: Pause to appreciate the immense courage Trump is displaying daily on the campaign trail](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY DOUGLAS MACKINNON, [TOWNHALL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_After the latest scare on Sunday, where the Secret Service opened fire on a man with an AK-47 outside of Trump International Golf Course in West Palm Beach while former President Donald J. Trump was on the course, I believe we all need pause to appreciate the immense courage Trump displays daily on the campaign trail._
_This is what President Trump put out immediately after the incident: “There were gunshots in my vicinity, but before rumors start spiraling out of control, I wanted you to hear this first: I AM SAFE AND WELL! Nothing will slow me down. I will NEVER SURRENDER! I will always love you for supporting me.”_
_Legend. That is the only word that comes to mind._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Rep. Boebert sets mobile office hours at five locations Sept. 18-19 and 24](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | SEPTEMBER 16** _Residents of the 3rd Congressional District are invited to participate in one of five mobile office events being offered Sept. 18-19 and 24 with staff from U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert’s office._
**[Devotional: Which tree will you choose? Life or death?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 13** _L_ _et’s chat about something that should be prioritized: getting in tune with God’s wisdom (Proverbs 3). Picture this: the world is like a sneaky influencer, whispering sweet nothings that can lead us astray without realizing it._
**_[Ganahl: Colorado’s ties to Kamala’s lies about later term abortion](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY HEIDI GANAHL | STATE | SEPTEMBER 13** _One of Kamala Harris’s most glaring falsehoods during the recent presidential debate was her dismissal of Donald Trump’s claim that abortion is legal and on demand at any point during pregnancy in some states. Harris confidently declared, “Nowhere in America is a woman carrying a pregnancy to term and asking for an abortion. That is not an abortion. That is not happening.” But the truth is, it *is* happening—right here in Colorado._

#

Team -
In exactly seven weeks from today, it’s Election Day. People will be casting their ballots for elections across the nation. Some people will vote as soon as next week through early voting.
Our gun safety majority in the Senate hangs on by a thread. We currently have a House of Representatives led by a Speaker who refuses to bring any gun safety legislation to the floor for a vote. The race between Vice President Kamala Harris and Donald Trump is neck-and-neck.
If we were to slow down in our work to take back the House, maintain our Senate majority, and elect Vice President Harris, the results we wake up to on November 6th could be catastrophic for our movement for gun safety.
We’re sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.
We’re so proud to have endorsed 183 candidates so far this cycle, including gun safety champions running for state legislatures, US Senate, and the US House. Not to mention Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz and in their bid for the White House! All the candidates we’ve endorsed have pledged to do the work to keep our communities safe from gun violence.
In the home stretch of this election, we’re working hard to get out the vote for gun safety champions up and down the ballot. But we need the resources to continue in this important work.

There’s less than 50 days left and we’re getting the word out because it’s _National Voter Registration Day_! Team, if you’re reading this, we **hope** you’re already registered to vote!

Is your grandma registered? Is your roommate? _Is your crush from middle school???_

SkyTree Book Fair offers schools a different option for book fairs. SkyTree Book Fairs is providing schools, parents, and children with an empowering alternative with literature rooted in truth and family values that matches the quality and ease of Scholastic while countering their harmful agenda. Why this matters: You may remember Scholastic book fairs. All the kids used to love it when they came to school. It was a catalog of all the stories I got to read. It used to be an innocent event. Unfortunately, that's all changed. Scholastic now promotes woke, radical LGBT books. They promote a radical agenda over the well-being of kids. And make no mistake, Scholastic is the nation's leading hotbed. Ellie Berger, president of Scholastic's trade publishing division, wrote, "We pledge to stand with you as we redouble our efforts to combat the laws restricting children's access to books." With over 120,000 book fairs a year, Scholastic is the biggest pusher of transgender, woke propaganda to school children. That's why it's urgent we create more SkyTree book fairs. SkyTree will not only promote age-appropriate books, but they will do so more efficiently to make it easier for schools to choose SkyTree over Scholastic. However, SkyTree Book Fairs is a David VS. Goliath battle. SkyTree has already secured its first public school book fair in Spotsylvania, VA! No more racially divisive storylines. No more confusing gender content. Only age-appropriate content that will nurture childhood innocence and character. SkyTree needs your support today. American children need your support today!! We are quickly lining up hundreds of new book fairs in the Spring semester. It costs roughly $4,500 to host each book fair. Please help sponsor SkyTree book fairs in schools across the country. - Since I began sharing my story, I've received death threats and ugly and twisted threatening messages on social media. The media has labeled me an extremist. I 've even been physically assaulted by a mob of transgender activists. But I'm not afraid. Instead I think of what God tells us in Romans 8:18:_I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us. You and I must take on this battle. We're called to do so. Let's step up and provide children with a positive alternative to what's happening in Scholastic book fairs by supporting SkyTree. I hope you will join me in supporting SkyTree to ensure that children have access to high-quality literature that aligns with our most cherished values and principles. body:

|
> **My opponent supports “Sanctuary Cities,” calls illegal immigrants “law-abiding citizens,” oh...and he doesn’t like the term “illegal.”**
---
Career politician Curtis Hertel, one of the most radical politicians in Lansing, believes we should open the border more, doesn’t want police arresting illegal immigrants, and calls illegal immigrants “law-abiding citizens.”
---
[_ _**Stop Illegal Immigration** _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66e98bdf737bbd78854dec6b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fbarrett-brigade-victory-fund%2Fopen-the-border-more&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66e8d89792fc9f7d0a084351&l=en-US&s=5OEZMckAGYUHGxxBNUKKBzki5e0%3D)
---
More than 10 million people have entered the country in the four years since Joe Biden and Kamala Harris took office - more than the entire population of Michigan. Harris was a complete failure as [the administration’s “Border Czar,”](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66e98bdf737bbd78854dec6b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fthehill.com%2Fopinion%2Fimmigration%2F4813704-kamala-harris-border-czar-denial%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66e8d89792fc9f7d0a084351&l=en-US&s=cgqEhsPXL21Oxd3Nej95nUwfRyY%3D) supporting ending construction of the border wall, ending Title 42 restrictions, and encouraging Central Americans to come to America, which led to mass migration to our southern border.
---
