| | Dear Fellow American, Classic children's literature is being ignored and eliminated from our nation's classrooms at an alarming rate. Beloved classics like _The Wind in the Willows_ , _Treasure Island_ , and _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ are just a few of the foundational books that are rarely being taught to our nation's children today. Not only does this rob young people of classic tales of adventure and friendship, but they also rob children of fundamental lessons about the world and how best to live.

| The Texas Senate HHS Committee is having a hearing this week to discuss the implementation of SB 7. In effect since February 2024, **SB 7 prohibits all employers from requiring the COVID vaccine and protects _everyone_** \- not just employees, but also students, volunteers, interns, and prospective new hires. Any employer persisting in requiring this vaccine faces a **$50,000 penalty per violation** , yet TFVC continues to receive reports of employers, primarily healthcare sites, **pushing the jab on unsuspecting Texans**. Have you been asked to provide proof of COVID-19 vaccination for employment, volunteer work or healthcare related coursework in 2024 in violation of SB 7? **Your story can help make an impact at this hearing! ** ****Tell us how these mandates have impacted you or your family since they were outlawed by [clicking the button below](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTcxMTc0NTM0NDQyOTE2MDIwJmM9cDNuOCZlPTAmYj0xMzYzNDkyOTU3JmQ9eDN6NnE4Yw==.Iyq2PFrH_vsn7GTIBJTv7d7Gc_abwNgOSb0l5Gf1hDw). **We are honored to serve as your voice** in Austin and ensure these businesses come into compliance with Texas law.

Will you join me in supporting state Democrats nationwide by investing in the DLCC? | | | | | ---|--- Hi there – With only 49 days until polls close, I’m reaching out with a critical message: Progress is possible but not guaranteed. Now more than ever, the DLCC and state Democrats are relying on your support to elect Democratic leaders who will protect our fundamental freedoms and secure a brighter future for all Americans. Over the past few months, it’s become clear: Something is happening in our country. You can feel it. It’s something we've worked for and dreamed of for a long time – hope has returned to our politics. I feel hopeful that with ongoing hard work, we will secure victory up and down the ballot this fall, and stop the spread of Trumpism to preserve our democracy. But we have a long road ahead. Even without Trump in the White House, Republicans have continued to relentlessly threaten our freedoms to make our own decisions about our health, our lives, our loves, and our families, yielding their razor-thin majorities in states like Arizona to pass far-right legislation. But if we come together to elect state Democrats this November, we can loosen Republicans’ tight grip on our legislatures and block their extreme agenda. body:
A special event with our Congresswoman. | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
# Join us to “Paint it Red” on Wednesday Oct 2!
---
| Please join us for our “Paint it Red” dinner reception with guest of honor Congresswoman Cathy McMorris Rodgers in Spokane - on the evening of Wednesday, October 2.
Please click [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=95ef09cf7b&e=5a45b9550e) to RSVP or contact anitra@votebaumgartner.com for more details.
---
[](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=4668899e58&e=5a45b9550e)
|
# On the road: Clarkston, Walla Walla, Pullman, and more...
---
| Once again we have been racking up the miles all over Eastern Washington!
We’ve made campaign stops in **Ritzville** to talk with local officials, and on to meet with farmers and voters in Franklin County, followed by an event in **Clarkston** , visits to the **Pullman High School** civics class (Go Greyhounds!), an interview with **Pullman Radio** , and a stop at the **Palouse Empire Fair** in Colfax where it was great to see Palouse agricultural legend Alex McGregor and his wife Linda.
We had a very fun time campaigning at the **WSU Coug game** vs. Texas Tech. It was a special weekend for me as my good friend, former Coach Mike Leach, was inducted into the WSU Hall of Fame.
---
|
---
| We also had members of the campaign team at the GOP booth at the **Columbia County Fair,** handing out materials.
During last week I really appreciated hearing more about law enforcement issues from County Sheriffs serving our communities across Eastern Washington. These discussions of policy are so essential and I was grateful to everyone taking time out of busy schedules.
Finally this past weekend we were at the **Fall Festival in Connell** and at **Sprague Community Days** \- and of course our family of die-hard Coug fans cheered on WSU in their Apple Cup victory!
---
| **Upcoming dates**
---
| Here are details of upcoming debates and forums scheduled with my Democrat opponent. Save the dates!
**September 24:** Walla Walla candidate forum (co-hosted by AAUW, Walla Walla-Union Bulletin, Walla Walla Chamber of Commerce)**October 3:** Rotary 21 lunch debate, Spokane**October 8:** Gonzaga University debate (co-hosted by The Spokesman and Spokane Public Television)**October 21:** Foley Institute debate, WSU, Pullman (co-hosted by KHQ)**October 30:** KREM debate, Spokane
You can also help by **hosting a yard sign** , **doorbelling with us** on Sundays (or, you can knock on doors in your area any time - just ask us for a list!) Contact erich@votebaumgartner.com.
(Note: We have a campaign office in Spokane where you can collect signs. Outside Spokane, we have signs with local GOP party contacts. If you don’t have their information, let us know and we’ll help.)
Please be in touch if you would like to know more about **writing a letter to the editor.**
We have** 50 DAYS** until the General Election! Thank you for your support - let’s keep working!
-Michael

---
[DONATE!](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=964357c0cb&e=5a45b9550e)

When I worked for Planned Parenthood, I saw how difficult it was for pregnant people in red states to access affordable reproductive care. Now, with Trump’s Supreme Court ripping away the protections of _Roe v. Wade_ , the situation is even more dire. Just look at what’s going on in Louisiana: Misoprostol is an essential part of reproductive health care. It’s used in emergencies like postpartum hemorrhaging, miscarriage treatment, labor induction, and intrauterine device (IUD) insertion. **But because misoprostol can also be used in abortion care, right-wing legislators in Louisiana have declared it a “controlled dangerous substance,” putting up extra barriers for doctors who need it in life-or-death situations.** The situation is even worse for rural and remote hospitals without in-house pharmacies, particularly on nights and weekends. “I’ve been [at a rural hospital] trying to get a simple headache medication released, and it’s taken 45 minutes, an OB-GYN in New Orleans told the _Louisiana Illuminator_ , “In these [hemorrhage] situations, you don’t have 45 minutes.” **It’s a pattern I saw over and over again at Planned Parenthood: Anti-abortion politicians passing restrictions that help no one, put women’s lives in danger and make doctors’ jobs harder.** _**[Please join me and add your name if you agree: We must protect access USO Supporter,
I was born on a United States Air Force base in the Philippines and watched both my dad and stepmom proudly serve in the USAF as I was growing up.
Today, as a USO Global Ambassador, I'm proud to support all our heroes who serve across every branch of our military -- but there will still always be a special place in my heart for the United States Air Force ♥️.
**That 's why I'm hoping you'll join me ahead of the USAF's 77th birthday on Sept. 18 to give a heartfelt thank-you to all our brave airmen and service members. [Will you add your name next to mine on the USO's Air Force birthday card now to help us reach our 77,000-signature goal before midnight tomorrow?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/~8eXC0-YLmF2/RXRHQTNWK0Z4M3l0MHhQRWsxT3BlelpZcnNTaTlyVTlhblJaZFhBZ1JiN0NPc2hkSFRPbnd6eEZTU2tNYkx3eGFxSjNjSXhrL1lXZDQyclNBRU0xMzZKZEFjVFd2eWtyeUV3ek8rTmtBV1U9S0/Q25EOENaT3hBNWVaS2hhcUJ5aVJtamkzdUNNUVB3RERySWZudjdQdTR6aFluK09sc2x0bSt4L0tFdzZUZmc1YW43NTdzM1kvR1JHNTJUdlgzSk1jZEFpSmxYQ0FGczgyS0)**
[SIGN THE CARD](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/k3vwHbGd-wCm/RXRHQTNWK0Z4M3l0MHhQRWsxT3BlelpZcnNTaTlyVTlhblJaZFhBZ1JiN0NPc2hkSFRPbnd6eEZTU2tNYkx3eGFxSjNjSXhrL1lXZDQyclNBRU0xMzZKZEFjVFd2eWtyeUV3ek8rTmtBV1U9S0/Q25EOENaT3hBNWVaS2hhcUJ5aVJtamkzdUNNUVB3RERySWZudjdQdTR6aFluK09sc2x0bSt4L0tFdzZUZmc1YW43NTdzM1kvR1JHNTJUdlgzSk1jZEFpSmxYQ0FGczgyS0)
---
Growing up in a military family made me develop a lifelong appreciation and respect for our service members -- _and_ those who support them.
I saw firsthand how powerful it was for my parents when they heard a quick, genuine expression of thanks for their service. It not only gave them the strength to keep striving to be their best, but it also helped me appreciate the value of what our family was doing for our country.
That's why I know what a message of gratitude from military supporters like you can mean to our service members, especially at times when they're risking their lives on dangerous deployments far away from their families.
**It is the least we can do to remind those who sacrifice so much to keep us free and safe that we support them -- but it truly means so much. **
So please: **[Add your name now to help us gather 77,000 names via email and text message on our United States Air Force birthday card before midnight tomorrow to thank all our courageous heroes who serve!](https://links.e.uso.)**

---
Thank you for helping us deliver a powerful message to the members of our Air Force and all our Armed Forces.
With gratitude,

name: The Editors at Broad + Liberty
subject: How Philly’s Creative Circles Stay Separate
body:
Op-ed by Thom Nickels | B+L Featured Columnist | | | |
---
| | | _**_Thom Nickels:_ Who is an artist?**_
---
|
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5a09144713&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| "The different arts communities in Philadelphia — theater, painting, poetry and literature — are like individual fish bowls arranged along the top of a wall. Each community is its own enclave or kingdom. Actors hang with other actors, visual artists keep company with other visual artists, and poets and writers generally keep to their own circles unless they have to jump bowls and write about actors or the visual artists.

This arrangement is confining, parochial, and limiting. It’s also a Philadelphia thing because, at least according to a poet friend of mine, the various arts communities in New York behave in a different fashion: they mix and mingle freely with one another..."
---
| [Read More](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=597ac3cba4&e=b7b3eddce2 "Read More")
---
|
---
|
## About Thom Nickels:
---
| |

Thom Nickels is a Philadelphia-based journalist/columnist and the 2005 recipient of the AIA Lewis Mumford Award for Architectural Journalism. He writes for City Journal, New York, and Frontpage Magazine. Thom Nickels is the author of fifteen books, including “[Literary Philadelphia](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=59d652c469&e=b7b3eddce2)” and ”[From Mother Divine to the Corner Swami: Religious Cults in Philadelphia](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5588d1a77b&e=b7b3eddce2).” His latest is “[Death in Philadelphia: The Murder of Kimberly Ernest](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9494835d0e&e=b7b3eddce2).” He is currently at work on “The Last Romanian Princess and Her World Legacy,” about the life of Princess Ileana of Romania.
---

| We at [_Broad + Liberty_](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=728e65fedf&e=b7b3eddce2) are proud to present Thom's writings, and to provide readers across our region, state and beyond, with insightful, original investigative reports, and thought-leadership, on education, crime, business and government.

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92998749/499015568/1610638071?refcode=em20240917mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=ace0ccf5-0d75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhY2UwY2NmNS0wZDc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CL5Gk-4kPqdWjvMz84jgweTy4Dyk8jaL5CaZkygLZos=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress.**

Our race was the closest in the country, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs. I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92998759/499015594/1610638071?refcode=em20240917mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=ace0ccf5-0d75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhY2UwY2NmNS0wZDc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CL5Gk-4kPqdWjvMz84jgweTy4Dyk8jaL5CaZkygLZos=)

clean_body: Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad. Hello, Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad. For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before Roe v. Wade ... = Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats. Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue. My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy. Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not. What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages. Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor. I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme. Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you for letting me share some of my story with you. We didn’t know which state it would be about or the name of the woman, but we knew there would come a day when a woman would die from lack of access to modern reproductive healthcare. _“Her state had made performing the procedure a felony, with few exceptions. Any doctor who violated the new Georgia law could be prosecuted and face up to a decade in prison. Thurman waited in pain in a hospital bed, worried about what would happen to her 6-year-old son, as doctors monitored her infection spreading, her blood pressure sinking and her organs beginning to fail._

_It took 20 hours for doctors to finally operate. By then, it was too late.”_

We need to make something clear: **in Georgia, like ALL abortion-ban states, the legislature is overwhelmingly MALE.** MEN

body:
There’s no question: Latino voters will play a decisive role this November
|
---

Hi Peter,
I’m thrilled to kick off Hispanic Heritage Month with a warm welcome to the entire AOTL community. ¡Bienvenidos!
I love this celebration because it offers an intentional moment to recognize the significant impact Latinos/Latinas have had on our country.
This year’s Hispanic Heritage Month theme is “Pioneers of Change: Shaping the Future Together.” This is so apt for this year, heading into election season, because Latino/Latina voters _will_ shape the future together while we honor the pioneering spirit of our ancestors.
According to the U.S. Census Bureau, the Latino/Latina population in the United States today is over 62 million people — or close to 20% of the total population — making it the largest racial or ethnic minority group and the second-largest group of voting age Americans.
**There’s no question: Latino/Latina voters will play a decisive role in November’s election.**
And according to UnidosUS, the nation’s largest Latino/Latina civil rights and advocacy organization, it’s estimated that 1 in 4 Latino/Latina voters will be casting their ballot _for the very first time_. This highlights the critical impact Latino/Latina voters will continue to have on future elections.
In such an extreme election environment, where some people will say almost anything to get a vote, first-time voters need to hear about the stakes of this election from people who believe in our fundamental rights and want to protect our democracy — they need to hear from people like you, Peter.

Friend: Today is Citizenship Day, and I'll never forget what it felt like to finally become an American citizen.
When I was 14, my mother made the decision to bring me and my sisters to the United States. It wasn't easy moving thousands of miles away from our home in Ecuador to a new country, but I knew as soon as we arrived that _this_ would be my new home.

The United States promised a future that I couldn't have had in Ecuador — a future filled with hope and opportunity, free from political violence and instability. It promised the American dream.

I fell in love with this country immediately, and that's why, as soon as I had the chance to become a citizen, I didn't hesitate to take it. I spent long hours studying to pass the exam, memorizing _everything_ about our nation, from the founding fathers to the branches of government.

I can still remember my naturalization ceremony like it was yesterday. I was _so_ excited to join the hundreds of other immigrants who were also celebrating this monumental occasion. I remember smiling at my family — who, of course, were there with me — and amid all my excitement, letting out a sigh of relief and thinking:_ I am home_.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93000944/499023054/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1912-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzUyOGE2YmYtMTA3NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SvGRnWGDEhwCoS7xDMtm07QVaybC-MeqIB14aOEIP0A=)
My path to becoming a citizen was not one I took alone, friend. My family is the reason I was able to achieve my American dream: to go to college, start a career giving back to the community, and eventually become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress.

While in Congress, I had the privilege of speaking at naturalization ceremonies and sharing in their joy, just as my family had shared mine. And every ceremony I attended reminded me of how fortunate we are, as U.S. citizens, to have our freedoms and rights guaranteed; to know our government will protect us; and to have the right to choose our leaders.

These aren't freedoms I take for granted. But these days, I'm seeing extremist, corrupt politicians threaten the foundation of our democracy, pushing the American dream out of reach for most families.
**I'm living my American dream. So now, I'm running for Senate to give every family, here in Florida and across the country, the opportunities to pursue their own American Dream. ****But I can't do this alone, friend. **
**Right now, polling data shows me catching up to Rick Scott — and that means every dollar donated could mean the difference between winning or losing in November._[Please, will you donate $5 — or whatever you can spare before midnight tonight — to help me flip Florida, keep the Senate blue, and protect our democracy?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93000945/499023055/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1912-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzUyOGE2YmYtMTA3NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SvGRnWGDEhwCoS7xDMtm07QVaybC-MeqIB14aOEIP0A=)_**

body:
| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93001661/499025674/509024324?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2OWY5NjIwLTEyNzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7zmj0LcZlmfC1qWvi53OOaME-6L_k5hysvDcbWBU_n8=&emci=3a13032e-8774-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e69f9620-1275-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230)Dear Peter, **Happy National Voter Registration Day!** Let’s celebrate our democracy today by making sure that you’re geared up to vote. The first step is making sure you are registered to vote or that your registration is up to date by October 15th so you’re set to receive your ballot. [You can do so here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93001665/499025678/-69050507?lang=en&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2OWY5NjIwLTEyNzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7zmj0LcZlmfC1qWvi53OOaME-6L_k5hysvDcbWBU_n8=&emci=3a13032e-8774-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e69f9620-1275-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230) The next step is visiting our newly launched **[Voter Resources](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93001669/499025681/509024324?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2OWY5NjIwLTEyNzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7zmj0LcZlmfC1qWvi53OOaME-6L_k5hysvDcbWBU_n8=&emci=3a13032e-8774-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e69f9620-1275-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230) **to help answer any voting questions you might have! Are you new to Oregon and unfamiliar with our landmark vote-by-mail system? Did you know we have free postage when you mail your ballot back?**Find the answers to these questions and more on our[website](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93001671/499025686/509024324?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2OWY5NjIwLTEyNzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7zmj0LcZlmfC1qWvi53OOaME-6L_k5hysvDcbWBU_n8=&emci=3a13032e-8774-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e69f9620-1275-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230). ** For Portland voters, there's even more info about all the changes in our city government and voting system. Portland ballots will look a little different this year, as they will include Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) for city elections for the first time. Our resources will help you prepare and know what to expect, and even participate in a RCV mock election. **You can use our[Voter Resources](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93001673/499025688/509024324?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2OWY5NjIwLTEyNzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7zmj0LcZlmfC1qWvi53OOaME-6L_k5hysvDcbWBU_n8=&emci=3a13032e-8774-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e69f9620-1275-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230) to learn about:**
* What RCV is and how it works for City of Portland elections
* Participate in our mock RCV election
* How voting in Oregon works
* How to check your voter registration and/or register to vote
* And find more additional resources for voting information!

We hope that our **[Voter Resources](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93001675/499025690/509024324?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2OWY5NjIwLTEyNzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7zmj0LcZlmfC1qWvi53OOaME-6L_k5hysvDcbWBU_n8=&emci=3a13032e-8774-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e69f9620-1275-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230)** answer all your voting questions but if not, we are here to answer any further questions! Sincerely,
Britney VanCitters
OLCV Political & Organizing Director |

The first step is making sure you are registered to vote or that your registration is up to date by October 15th so you’re set to receive your ballot. **" Pipeline fire continues to burn in Deer Park,"** KHOU's**Jamie E. Galvan** -- "Flames continue to shoot from a pipeline in Deer Park, nearly a full day after it ignited. The City of Deer Park said crews worked through the night on the fire and that it's smaller than it was on Monday.

The fire started just before 10 a.m. Monday at [Spencer Highway near East Boulevard](https://substack.com/redirect/ee2709b6-bc5e-4595-b1da-6a726a9b8111?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) near the Brookglen neighborhood.

As for how it happened, the city said an SUV crashed through the fence of a nearby Walmart and hit an above-ground valve, sparking the fire. Energy Transfer officials said they turned off the gas and are allowing the remnants to burn off. Tuesday morning, they said the burn-off would go through later in the day.

They added that this was the safest way to manage the incident. Energy Transfer said they are also providing lodging for those affected.

Four people, including a firefighter, were injured in the fire. Two of them were taken to area hospitals for treatment.

A third-party air monitoring company has been contracted by Energy Transfer, according to the La Porte Office of Emergency Management.

Hundreds of residents between Luella Dr. and Canada and Spencer Highway and Oakhaven/Eagle Run [were advised to evacuate](https://substack.com/redirect/e601f842-0b28-45ea-a617-e7f73df69db1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Heritage Elementary and College Park Elementary were also evacuated, along with a nearby H-E-B and Walmart.

Firefighters were spraying nearby homes to try and protect them but smoke could be seen coming from some rooftops.

"The fire, it's very hot, so a lot of the house structures that are adjacent to that are still catching on fire even though we're putting a lot of water on them," Deer Park Mayor **Jerry Mouton Jr**. said.

Harris County Commissioner **Adrian Garcia** said this pipeline runs along the city limits between Deer Park and La Porte, so emergency responders from both cities are reacting to the fire.

The City of Deer Park said crews worked through the night on the fire and that it's smaller than it was on Monday. The fire started just before 10 a.m. Monday at near the Brookglen neighborhood. As for how it happened, the city said an SUV crashed through the fence of a nearby Walmart and hit an above-ground valve, sparking the fire. Energy Transfer officials said they turned off the gas and are allowing the remnants to burn off. Tuesday morning, they said the burn-off would go through later in the day. They added that this was the safest way to manage the incident. Energy Transfer said they are also providing lodging for those affected. Four people, including a firefighter, were injured in the fire. Two of them were taken to area hospitals for treatment. A third-party air monitoring company has been contracted by Energy Transfer, according to the La Porte Office of Emergency Management. Hundreds of residents between Luella Dr. and Canada and Spencer Highway and Oakhaven/Eagle Run . Heritage Elementary and College Park Elementary were also evacuated, along with a nearby H-E-B and Walmart. Firefighters were spraying nearby homes to try and protect them but smoke could be seen coming from some rooftops. "The fire, it's very hot, so a lot of the house structures that are adjacent to that are still catching on fire even though we're putting a lot of water on them," Deer Park Mayor Jerry Mouton Jr. said. Harris County Commissioner Adrian Garcia said this pipeline runs along the city limits between Deer Park and La Porte, so emergency responders from both cities are reacting to the fire. body:
It's National Voter Registration Day – are you registered?

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93002885/499030066/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240917_logo&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjdlY2NkYjUtMTU3NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=M9hVDl0yHBC0bwl1C57Xc_07u2Dwlal7vuimFNOldQU=)
Peter,

It’s National Voter Registration Day!

Organizations and campaigns across the country are making a major push today to get voters registered ahead of the 2024 election. Since the clock is ticking down even faster in Mississippi, here’s how you can participate today:
1. Register to vote! If you live in Mississippi, you can find information about where to register [here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93002887/499030068/-1125032784?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjdlY2NkYjUtMTU3NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=M9hVDl0yHBC0bwl1C57Xc_07u2Dwlal7vuimFNOldQU=&emci=b48bc27f-1575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=b7eccdb5-1575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9272760) If you’re already registered, you can double check that your information is accurate, update any details, or find information about your polling place [here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93002889/499030070/-1541237797?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjdlY2NkYjUtMTU3NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=M9hVDl0yHBC0bwl1C57Xc_07u2Dwlal7vuimFNOldQU=&emci=b48bc27f-1575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=b7eccdb5-1575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9272760)

2. Talk to your friends and family. The best way to amplify our message is word of mouth. Check in with your neighbors and loved ones to make sure they’re registered and have a plan to vote on Election Day.

3. Support our work on the ground. Our campaign is working in every corner of Mississippi to register voters over the next 19 days, and we can’t do it without your support. ---

|
---
|
# On the Move with Patti
---
| _Keeping supporters updated with news, events, and ways to help me win the race for Congress in Coastal Georgia._
---
|
---
|
---
|
# The Race is Heating Up
---
| Since the beginning of September, I’ve been criss-crossing the District speaking with voters and constituency groups about her vision for prosperity for more people.
---
[](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=44b9a9aa89&e=0f456155ff)
|
---
|
---
|
# Signs of Change
---
| As I travel across the district, I’m energized by all the people I meet who share our vision for change. Everywhere I go, I see growing excitement for Our Time, Our Turn. Together, we are building a movement for real change, and you can feel that momentum growing with every step.

Speaking of momentum, you might have noticed our new mini-billboards starting to pop up around town. These signs are a great way to show our pride and unity. They let others know that Democrats are here and ready to make a difference. They’re a powerful symbol of collective action, a reminder that we’re all in this fight together.

I’ve had so many people tell me how excited they are to see these signs in their towns, and it’s clear that folks want to see more! If you have a high-visibility spot where we can proudly display one, please let us know! Every sign we plant helps show that our voices are being heard.

A huge thank you to all our incredible sign sponsors for your support—together, we can make sure no one in this district misses our message of hope and change. Let’s keep this momentum going—can I count on you to sponsor a sign and help us create even more visibility?
[_**Click here to Sponsor A Sign**_](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=23cc2a5dfe&e=0f456155ff) _**.**_
---
[](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=7ecd144bad&e=0f456155ff)
| _**NOTE: Grandson not included!**_
---
|
---
|
---
|
# Staying Connected
---
| I’ve been busy attending in-person events across the district, but campaign events are becoming more virtual each year!

A big thank you to the [Savannah Federation of Democratic Women](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=c24d6fb694&e=0f456155ff) for hosting me at their September meeting, as well as to [Moms Demand Action for Common Sense Gun Control](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=e13d0faeb4&e=0f456155ff).

[The Fighting Five event](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=b82c8021d9&e=0f456155ff) event brought together five women running for Congress, including me, to share our vision for Georgia and unite supporters statewide. Thank you for those who attended, your support keeps us moving forward!

I also thank Jerome Irving for having me on his podcast, [Vulnerable Communities](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=eadfae4895&e=0f456155ff), and giving me the opportunity to connect with more voters.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
# Where to Next?
---
| Join me on the Campaign Trail and hear me speak at these upcoming events:
* **Friday, September 20th** at the [McIntosh Democratic Committee Rally](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=736a0caac3&e=0f456155ff) at the Sapelo Saltwater Fishing Club.
* **Saturday, September 21st** at the [Southeast Blues & BBQ Festival](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=c24f0a929a&e=0f456155ff) at St. Mary’s park in Camden County.
* **Sunday, September 22nd** at the [Women’s Voices of Glynn](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=c5c76fabc8&e=0f456155ff) Forum at the Universal Unitarian Church in Brunswick.

---
|
---
|
# Exciting News!
---
| I will be making an exciting announcement soon. Make sure you’re following our [Facebook](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=4648b618b7&e=0f456155ff) and/or [Instagram](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=f5dc700c7f&e=0f456155ff) page because it’s going to be epic!

My campaign released its [second](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d438e0e289&e=a7ab36849c)[ video](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3098c4085a&e=a7ab36849c), focused on my opponent's real record on securing the border.

Here are some highlights on my opponent's Border stance:
* She supports amnesty for millions of illegal immigrants, who she claims “are filling jobs that employers can’t find other Americans to do.” In the meantime, she supports letting certain undocumented immigrants “get a driver’s license or occupational license” as well as in-state tuition and state-funded financial aid. She also voted against legislation requiring prospective voters in Arizona to provide evidence that they are U.S. citizens.
* She voted against the Arizona Border Invasion Act and the Secure the Border Act — both of which would empower law enforcement to protect families against threats from drug cartels and other violent criminals at the southern border — and falsely claimed that these bills would do “nothing to secure the border or make any of us one bit safer.”
* She also voted against declaring drug cartels as terrorist organizations and voted against declaring cross-border fentanyl trafficking as a public health crisis.
* She voted against recognizing the service of Border Patrol; voted against urging Governor Katie Hobbs to mobilize the National Guard to the border; voted against the establishment of (and funding for) the exploitation at the Border Fund; and said that “I appreciate Governor Hobbs’s new direction” after Hobbs proposed cutting funding from the Border Strike Force.
* She repeatedly opposed state and federal efforts to construct a barrier along the U.S.-Mexico border, which she deemed “unnecessary,” and she pressured Congress to include “not one penny for a border wall” in its upcoming spending package.
* She opposed everyday Arizonans who live near the Border from erecting their own border wall on their own private property.
* She has accepted support and funding from her “friends” at Living United for Change in Arizona (LUCHA), a radical open-borders group that supports abolishing ICE and berates our law enforcement officers with chants like “Chinga la Migra” (“Fuck Border Patrol”).
* She also called on the Biden administration to drastically increase the number of refugees admitted into the U.S. to 125,000 refugees per year.

_A vote for Shawnna Bolick means I will continue to fight for resources to secure our border, fund law enforcement, and increased penalties on drug dealers and cartels. _

**This election is about the future of Arizona. Can you help us invest in keeping our second ad by[ chipping in today](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4c26bac117&e=a7ab36849c)?**

Our communities are suffering under an open border. If the voters keep me in office, we can continue work to keep taxes low, fight inflation, and continue making our neighborhoods safer.

I promise to keep fighting for the prosperity and safety of everyday Arizonans. Let's stand together to win!

Take care,
Shawnna

| **KRQE Interview** Nella Domenici recently did a 25-minute interview with KRQE’s senior anchor Dean Staley. Nella clearly proved she’s the bipartisan leader New Mexico needs, while Martin Heinrich deserves to be fired after 20 years of abject failure!

| **Cost of Living** For too many New Mexican families, there’s more month than paycheck. It shouldn’t be this way, but out-of-control federal spending has led to increased inflation. That means that basic necessities, like bread, milk, and laundry soap cost more than they used to.
Nella [addressed how Martin Heinrich’s votes in the U.S. Senate helped set the stage for the inflation](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=f98db4a00c&e=780129cd82) that is eating at your budget.

| Martin Heinrich has spent 20 years as a politician. And what do we have to show for it? Have a look at newsclips spanning his time in office. New Mexico’s crime rate has increased, schools are failing, and the cost of goods has skyrocketed.
Martin Heinrich’s policies have made all of those issues **worse** for New Mexico.
It’s time to fire Martin Heinrich.

| | | | | | | | | | | **The Dog Days of Summer** Summer is wrapping up as September marches on. I made a new friend in Wagon Mound, where T-Bone joined me for the Bean Day parade.
Nobody gave us any beans, though.
The very next week we barked around again at the State Fair Parade! That was a long one! So long that T-Bone rode on the float while I huffed it!
I love parades. Still no beans, and despite my new friend’s name, we didn’t get any steak, either.

WE'RE ON THE BRINK
Nuclear War is Closer Than Ever—
Help Me Stop It!
Dear Peter,
There’s no greater issue facing our country – and the world – than the reckless march toward nuclear war.
Today, Secretary Blinken and the Biden administration are discussing a dangerous move to provide Ukraine with long-range Western-made missiles capable of striking deep into Russian territory. [**I’m calling on them to stop immediately:**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_17_24_una1&n=5)
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_17_24_una1&n=6)
This is about survival, not politics. The neoconservatives who pushed us into disastrous wars in Iraq, Libya, and Syria have taken over the Democratic Party, and they are driving us to the brink of nuclear conflict with Russia.
**Do you understand how dangerous this is?** Right now, our country is giving weapons, training, and targeting information to Ukraine to strike inside Russia. How would we react if Russia had military bases on our Mexican border and was helping Mexico target oil refineries, towns, and nuclear plants in Texas?
[If Russia becomes desperate, they **will** use nuclear weapons. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_17_24_una1&n=7)
The Biden administration and the foreign policy establishment are gambling with the future of the entire human race. And for what? Endless wars that have already bankrupted our nation. Now, they’re risking everything in an unnecessary and catastrophic confrontation with a nuclear power.
**We must step back from the brink – now.******
This is why I decided to leave the Presidential race and endorse Donald Trump. After many conversations with him, I believe he understands the gravity of this situation. Trump will deescalate tensions with Russia and put an end to the neocon agenda for war with Iran and China. I take him at his word, and I will also keep him to his word.
My immediate focus in Washington will be to ensure that President Trump can stop this reckless march toward nuclear war and return us to a government that puts **peace and the people** first.
[But I can’t do this without your immediate support. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_17_24_una1&n=8)
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_17_24_una1&n=9)
We are at a critical crossroads. I am committed to taking bold action to challenge the corruption entrenched in Washington and stop the neocon agenda that threatens all of us.
[Donate now](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=on_the_brink_9_17_24_una1&n=10) to give me the resources I need to end this escalation and restore a government that works for the people – before it’s too late.
Thank you for standing strong with me for the future of America.
| |

---
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

Friends,
I’m proud to endorse Karen Baker’s campaign for U.S. Congress! As a retired Federal Administrative Law Judge, a nurse, and a lawyer for over 45 years, Karen is ready to fight for what Southwest Virginia needs in Washington.
Karen is the Democratic nominee for Virginia’s 9th District, and I know she’s going to be a force for positive change in Washington.

Karen knows the struggles working families face every day because she has lived them – she raised her son, Sean, as a single mom for 15 years while working as a lawyer, judge, and nurse in a small rural hospital.
While in Congress, Karen will fight to level the playing field for the people of Southwest Virginia. She will work to secure good jobs and build a stronger economy for her community, ensure access to affordable housing, make child care more accessible, and support working families.

And you might be familiar with the person who did it... any guesses? = That’s right — it was Ken Calvert, the same Republican Will Rollins is now running to unseat. Calvert blamed “the times” and claims he has since changed, but his attacks on the LGBTQ+ community haven’t. He voted against the Matthew Shepard hate crimes bill. He voted against gay adoption and voted to keep us out of the military. I can’t think of a stronger rebuke of Calvert's long-standing, anti-LGBTQ+ agenda than replacing him with an openly gay prosecutor who will uphold the law and fight for equal rights. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. With each investment for college, he made a promise to come back home and serve his community as a physician. **Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. **As Dr. Carson's 73rd birthday approaches, we want to fill his desk with birthday wishes from patriots like you. Will you take a moment to[sign his birthday card](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=0622aa72943945209dc569b778b2095e&_e=EYT-av8FUq00Ej7YFAcaC1Rb2OGf47faRnvJhKBveBQLr-gemNG_qwbZI0I3MNtNXYMDxejs7qcivEnAEKbOsDuv6bE2PIDom6aVmm7Je_lAYm3w2e8Y7cxQ3rR6GC0xnDoFBOLEhZl-ryYMo8HtNdmtZIiCeCG_T9JURWeUZ4EGhRPNt4liAkzoDsyzW9649BrUQeJ4-zM443ePQNaYEw4jfDdlKH1ohXV4QiKLH-h7Yq-pPhiQcj0ebP5CV-joKlr4AYz4NrNobIZtodpZhVOloZQ_XXqOZXZWMGXRFkmDvJR4C4EtwOIHQZaEk8QZ19kMcgG-c90wRBdaOD6juxiVAx6rtHyVbIJHmj7QHRPIEwhjApLJ6ceF6Gon1ROH0YIVm9j_JdjjEJYF8zhl4wXWU3y_Z-O_dFOBYCPNoRY%3D) and add a personal note?**

By adding your name to this card, you're not just wishing Dr. Carson a happy birthday - you're also affirming the values and principles that guide us. Together, we can make a difference and reinforce the conservative cause.

[**Click here to add your name today!**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=0622aa72943945209dc569b778b2095e&_e=EYT-av8FUq00Ej7YFAcaC1Rb2OGf47faRnvJhKBveBQLr-gemNG_qwbZI0I3MNtNXYMDxejs7qcivEnAEKbOsDuv6bE2PIDom6aVmm7Je_lAYm3w2e8Y7cxQ3rR6GC0xnDoFBOLEhZl-ryYMo8HtNdmtZIiCeCG_T9JURWeUZ4EGhRPNt4liAkzoDsyzW9649BrUQeJ4-zM443ePQNaYEw4jfDdlKH1ohXV4QiKLH-h7Yq-pPhiQcj0ebP5CV-jo8unmOh3b-ifjnoUgYfWmQQnN3EtS-6-Ji-jdFdk8YwQKTbztZ5Kah0eVep8aByi52bRAXv2635ng1eKcIRCd5W4CpOYIFHHgBIOfkzSrJhOsbCY3i2mtX3j6QmwvGMHOqAjtlFSq0piMTU1dafPJTXGhvzwh77NGTR-l-K00B-k%3D)

Folks, as a young woman, I had an abortion. It’s not a secret. It’s not shameful. And I share it because I want the millions of other women who’ve made the decision to seek abortion care to know that they’re not alone. In my early 20s, I found out I was pregnant. I was married and wanted to start a family, but a devastating medical diagnosis changed all my plans. My doctors told me I had an aortic aneurysm at risk of rupture. To treat it, I first needed to have an abortion. **That abortion saved my life.** My right to make the decision that was best for me, my health, and my future was protected by _Roe v. Wade_. Women in Tennessee and other GOP-controlled states are now denied _any_ choice in their reproductive futures. It’s abhorrent. Let me be clear, the right to make our own reproductive health care decisions is fundamental. Women _cannot_ be equal if we don’t have control over our own bodies. When I get to Washington, I won’t hesitate to use every power available to demand a restoration of our reproductive freedoms at the federal level. We have to secure our rights and prevent radicals like Marsha Blackburn from enacting a national ban. **_[I’m asking you to make a small grassroots donation — just $3 or $5 — to help me fight for reproductive rights as Tennessee’s next Senator. # [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240917&t=1&akid=1190%2E587540%2E_Snsgg)
Peter,
**Leaders We Deserve and our co-founders, David Hogg and Kevin Lata, got featured in _Fast Company_ for the work we’re doing to elect more young people:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240917?refcode=em20240917&refcode2=1190_587540__Snsgg&akid=1190%2E587540%2E_Snsgg)
**[Can we count on you to join this movement to support the next generation of bold, progressive leadership? Donate $5 right now to power our work>>>](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240917?refcode=em20240917&amount=5&refcode2=1190_587540__Snsgg&akid=1190%2E587540%2E_Snsgg)**
The _Fast Company_ article covered a lot of ground, but here are some highlights:
* After surviving a school shooting at his high school in Parkland, Florida, David Hogg helped launch a student-led non-profit, March for Our Lives.

* David enrolled at Harvard, where he learned the history of conservative political movements and how they were playing the long game, winning state legislatures and appointing far-right judges, to beat progressives.

* In 2022, David supported the election of Maxwell Frost, the first Gen Z member of Congress, alongside his young campaign manager Kevin Lata.

* In 2023, David and Kevin founded Leaders We Deserve, an organization dedicated to electing the next generation of progressive political leaders.

In addition to highlighting the story of Leaders We Deserve, the _Fast Company_ article also featured Anna Thomas, Allie Phillips, and Ashwin Ramaswami, just a few of our endorsed candidates who are running in state legislative races this year.
_**Fast Company**_ **called Gen Z “the most politically engaged generation we’ve ever seen”** and all of us here at Leaders We Deserve couldn’t agree more. We see it in action every day with our incredible candidates and the young people who are stepping up to do the work volunteering on these history-making campaigns.
It’s pretty awesome to get featured in a national magazine — and hopefully, the media attention brings even more fired-up supporters into our organization!
**[Our work is just getting started, Peter. We need your support to elect our inspiring slate of young people this year — and to keep our momentum going next year and beyond. Please, pitch in $5 now to back us in this fight!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240917?refcode=em20240917&amount=5&refcode2=1190_587540__Snsgg&akid=1190%2E587540%2E_Snsgg)**

Thank you for your support!
Leaders We Deserve
P.S. Check out [**the full article from _Fast Company_**](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/1032?t=2&akid=1190%2E587540%2E_Snsgg) to see what else they had to say about Leaders We Deserve!

I was in Montana recently to rally support for Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy as he campaigns to unseat Jon Tester._

When I found out Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy was running for Senate in Montana, I knew I needed to help this decorated warfighter and true patriot defeat the Washington establishment incumbent, Jon Tester.

Friends,
We’re 49 days out from the most consequential election of our lifetime, and things are getting weird. And that’s not good for our democracy.
I wouldn’t have guessed that we’d be talking about Trump spreading false rumors about Haitian immigrants eating pets in Springfield, Ohio. Or that the Republican presidential nominee would be palling around with an unhinged 9/11 truther down the stretch. But that’s where we are.
What's worse is that Republicans in Congress like Nick LaLota are enabling this extremism. They've gotten so used to doing whatever Donald Trump says that they end up echoing his unhinged extremism.
Here’s just the latest example: During the presidential debate, Nick LaLota decided to push out some far-right meme about Vice President Harris that could have been cut and pasted from Laura Loomer's Twitter feed. Take a look for yourself.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonrevolt1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonrevolt1]
This is a right-wing fever dream pumped up by the extremists that gave us Project 2025. But Nick LaLota amplified that extremism willingly. Because that's who he really is. He's not one of the most bipartisan members of Congress. In fact, by the same study group he cites, he's the least bipartisan member of the Long Island delegation. That’s a fact.
Nick LaLota is a Trump toady who is far too far right for Suffolk County. He cheered the overturning of Roe v. Wade and even called for the repeal of New York’s own abortion law. He helped Trump kill the bipartisan border security bill that I would vote for on day one. And he believes that New York should *lower* the age to buy AR-15s. That’s not common sense.
So let’s restore decency, competence and honor to Congress. Let’s get common sense problem solving and rebuild the middle of our politics and our economy. Nick Lalota spends more time trying to be an internet troll than in doing his job. And that's why we’ll fire him this fall. Help us get there >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/john-avlon-for-congress-1?refcode=0917]
-John

During last week’s debate, Trump went even further, stating, _“I probably took a bullet to the head because of the things they say about me.”_

This should be a no-brainer... but with American gun culture buying into gun manufacturers' desire to play on our fears, some people still think it's OK to bring a deadly weapon with them to vote.
Add your name right now to demand that Congress acts to ensure that we have gun-free zones at our polling places and a place to exercise our democratic rights without fear of violence >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-congress-no-guns-at-the-polls-3?source=090324swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091724_2&amount=25]
Folks --
It’s time to ban guns from every polling place in America.
The voting booth should be a sanctuary of democracy. But every election year, we see reports of extremists openly carrying weapons as voters go to the polls – turning what should be a safe and welcoming experience into one of intimidation and fear.
That's why we're taking bold action to protect voters. Just this year, democracy activists like you helped pass laws restricting guns at polling places in New Mexico and Massachusetts – and with your action, we can bring this solution to every state in the nation.
Sign our petition to tell Congress: No guns at the polls! >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-congress-no-guns-at-the-polls-3?source=090324swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

With political tensions running high, it's more important than ever to ensure our polling places remain free from suppression and fear. No matter what you think about gun safety laws, banning guns at the polls is a commonsense step that every American who loves democracy should be able to agree on right now.
Our democracy works best when every voter feels safe and empowered. Voting is meant to be an act of hope – NOT fear – and with your help, we can make that a reality nationwide.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240917wu?refcode=lpfe240917wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240917wu?refcode=lpfe240917wu]
There are just seven weeks left until Election Day! As you know, seven is a very special number for our #TX07 campaign. So today, we’re bringing you a special edition of our weekly update with seven ways you can get involved and support our campaign—and other Democrats on the ballot in Texas—over the next seven weeks.
1. Sign up to blockwalk Saturdays [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678074/]
We will be knocking on doors this Saturday, September 21, with new literature and shifts from 9 a.m. to noon and noon to 3 p.m. We’re looking for volunteers to help us cover as much ground as possible to help voters make their plans for casting their ballots by Election Day.
2. Make calls with us [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678056/]
We have phone bank sessions weekly on Wednesdays from 4 to 7 p.m.! We’re talking to voters across our district and beyond about the importance of voting in November.
3. Write postcards with us [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678043/]
We have postcard parties on Thursday mornings and evenings—a fun and meaningful way to reach voters and encourage them to vote in this critical election.
4. Plant a yard sign! [https://mobilize.us/s/wUgOMT]
We are seeing yard signs pop up all over TX-07, and we love it! Some people still don’t know Lizzie is on the ballot this November, so this is a great way to raise awareness and show your support. We will have a drive-through yard sign pickup on Sunday (where you can also pick up postcards if you want). Can’t make it Sunday? We deliver. If you want a sign delivered, click here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lfcyardsign24?refcode=lfcyardsign24_campaignupdate]
5. Stock up on #TeamLizzie merch [https://store.lizziefletcher.com/]
Our merch store is full of shirts, stickers, mugs, and more, so get yours now and show off your #TeamLizzie pride. Another way to remind people she’s on the ballot in November—and you are on the team.
6. Check your voter registration [https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/voterDetails.do]
You may have seen news about Texas’s voter roll purge that removed more than 1 million Texans from the voter rolls. Some active voters have reported that it affected them, so we’re encouraging everyone to check their registration status before the voter registration deadline on October 7. If your registration is squared away, great! Now, you can forward this email to friends and family to help them make sure theirs is, too!

Thanks for all that you do, onwards to Election Day. — Team Casey

Hey Derek —
Today is National Voter Registration Day, and there's no better time to make sure you’re prepared to exercise your right to vote and make your voice heard ahead of the November elections.
Every time you vote, you exercise a fundamental right and strengthen your community.
Voting is the cornerstone of our democratic process, and we must protect it at all costs. We've seen firsthand how Trump and his MAGA allies have tried to undermine this fundamental right at every turn, and we’ve experienced the detrimental impacts of a corrupt campaign finance system that gives more power to corporations than voters.
With so much on the line in November — from reproductive rights and climate protection to education and housing — we can’t afford to sit this election out.
**So in honor of National Voter Registration Day, will you take a moment to either check your voter registration or register to vote?**
[REGISTER TO VOTE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/4826?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240917_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=7565%2E5257348%2E1LozVN)

---
With just 49 days until Election Day, it’s more important than ever to ensure that you, your family, and your friends are all registered to vote.
Please take a moment to double-check your registration, help others in your life do the same, and make sure everyone has a plan to vote.
Thank you!
– Team Schiff

body:
Will you do your part today by taking a few minutes to check your voter registration status and then make a plan to vote?
#
Happy National Voter Registration Day!
The stakes in November are high and the future of our democracy is at stake. So today, we’re asking you to get registered — or confirm your voter registration, or share this link with someone you know — to make sure everyone in our movement can cast a ballot in November.
**[Check Your Voter Registration Status →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/30212?refcode=em20240917-7217&t=1&akid=7217%2E2526796%2Eo4dIoC)**
We must do everything we can to elect Kamala Harris on November 5th, and stop fascism from re-entering the White House. Alexandria is committed to this critical work over the next 49 days.
**We must fight the politics of scarcity and fear with a positive plan for the future** where we guarantee health care to every person, decarbonize our economy, and win social, racial, economic, and environmental justice for every single working person in this country.
[**Will you do your part today by taking a few minutes to check your voter registration status and then make a plan to vote?**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/30212?refcode=em20240917-7217&t=2&akid=7217%2E2526796%2Eo4dIoC)

Thank you for being here.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

Susan Wild (PA-07) Red to Blue Candidates: Amish Shah (AZ-01) Adam Gray (CA-13) Derek Tran (CA-45) Curtis Hertel (MI-07) Kristen McDonald Rivet (MI-08) These candidates have extremely competitive races that will likely be among the tightest races in the country. Frontline Member, Hon. Yadira Caraveo was one of the closest Democratic victories in 2022, winning by fewer than 2,000 votes. Challenger Adam Gray lost CA-13 by just over 500 votes last cycle, and needs your help to cross the finish line this November. Hon. Susan Wild in PA-07 represents one of the most competitive toss-up districts in the country, and Derek Tran’s Orange County district was just moved by Cook Political Report from “Lean Republican” to “Toss Up”. Hon. Marcy Kaptur is the longest serving woman in Congress whose district got severely gerrymandered during redistricting. She is now running in a district Trump won, against an anti-abortion, MAGA extremist. Dark-money GOP groups have already committed to spend millions on air time against Hon. Gabe Vasquez in NM-02 and Hon. Jared Golden in ME-02. Republicans have also poured millions into Michigan, trying to buy the districts Curtis Hertel and Kristen McDonald Rivet are working hard to win. Amish Shah is running in Arizona’s 1st District, where he recently won a competitive six-way Primary and is working hard to raise funds while his opponent has a significant cash advantage. In 2022 the republican incumbent won by less than a single percentage point, this is a top pickup opportunity for House Democrats. These Red Alert candidates are working hard in their districts to reach voters at the doors and on the phones. They are making decisions about spending on TV in some of the most expensive media markets in the country, and need your help to fill the gap so they can get their message out and win in November. At the same time, dark-money Republican Super PACs are pouring millions of dollars into these districts. They need additional resources to fight against dark money attacks and to reach more voters and get out the vote on Election Day. I am asking YOU to= today to these 10 House Democratic candidates that have the toughest races in the nation, so we can take back the House Majority. = Thank you for all you do to help House Democrats. Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

**Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state._And I love this country._**

[**I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him, join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c7bfb5b924264177b7d5d54fea6c2dec&_e=S3S57D_RtFBaZJDdllCl9g3gL0w4sHexScd_cBwWxf88ZK2Du3y-AHTpMO4yEWw07xZA4G0a028pw8kcA0yPI4Cer78urr-PNheGsKox--CTFWGi5w8OlqGzstSGI0mxpXQqxaluybZmKMGzG7HmP0uxqavimWcbKwF7u6-HKSWNJVHrR2mdbn-4YQfQenRJ9WkrtO-9HyTqtDL58ThB06pXPWcqN4jn5SJAtU_LJerglcIIXtGj1kvBQYmd1u6ciDMn7lJbefkimD7f1S5ERgMrD1rUdftVH6ELmO4Ez45W7rajf52xF4L_nSPquiaZ_pPWdB4NewONjv7zWy7hDrM1_YUvVYZyGuyGELd2A_jcxyp2LK-B3BFGoS1zvPjoWo7dCTYEBfjuzvGFEWHgHesTlEOcQzUgPNDatQbrBvU%3D)

[** JOIN CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c7bfb5b924264177b7d5d54fea6c2dec&_e=S3S57D_RtFBaZJDdllCl9g3gL0w4sHexScd_cBwWxf88ZK2Du3y-AHTpMO4yEWw07xZA4G0a028pw8kcA0yPI4Cer78urr-PNheGsKox--CTFWGi5w8OlqGzstSGI0mxpXQqxaluybZmKMGzG7HmP0uxqavimWcbKwF7u6-HKSWNJVHrR2mdbn-4YQfQenRJ9WkrtO-9HyTqtDL58ThB06pXPWcqN4jn5SJAtU_LJerglcIIXtGj1kvBQYmd1u6ciDMn7lJbefkimD7f1S5ERouNX7MUhlKHFKABQeGfHgd-hKTl6U5LeHnGTXXqxkZkyywi0OHUtJfYa-ibdV4RgeGJ6WEcZ08ZcedOsICzw1WGevr5Apmo1YbxHzdaRKQe6iBqMt8J5G8H8MSr_vma0p8E1gdCZZMoevZ75OHI_BQ%3D)

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so-called “community” was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, on a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: _Hatred and Racism._ **Pathetic**.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

[**I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c7bfb5b924264177b7d5d54fea6c2dec&_e=S3S57D_RtFBaZJDdllCl9g3gL0w4sHexScd_cBwWxf88ZK2Du3y-AHTpMO4yEWw07xZA4G0a028pw8kcA0yPI4Cer78urr-PNheGsKox--CTFWGi5w8OlqGzstSGI0mxpXQqxaluybZmKMGzG7HmP0uxqavimWcbKwF7u6-HKSWNJVHrR2mdbn-4YQfQenRJ9WkrtO-9HyTqtDL58ThB06pXPWcqN4jn5SJAtU_LJerglcIIXtGj1kvBQYmd1u6ciDMn7lJbefkimD7f1S5ERo2ddxBvG6rnwYAhVyi9OvTnsicLWzd3gWg0pKvpivU-8lcQ2uh5Q76xcKPf4OSDB4PeD6Fd53_a7YzbM7WQR9Uh2J7c5fJukLSyOLBWUr_Nuxo75mq76d7tqyynKCfh8SCiXiKmkSCNQVPdYQx5yCk%3D)

We can look to him to promote prosperity for all—a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States. Our Constitution.

[**There comes a time when we have to speak out in support of our nation’s traditional values. For Patriotism. For the right to pursue happiness on our own terms.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c7bfb5b924264177b7d5d54fea6c2dec&_e=S3S57D_RtFBaZJDdllCl9g3gL0w4sHexScd_cBwWxf88ZK2Du3y-AHTpMO4yEWw07xZA4G0a028pw8kcA0yPI4Cer78urr-PNheGsKox--CTFWGi5w8OlqGzstSGI0mxpXQqxaluybZmKMGzG7HmP0uxqavimWcbKwF7u6-HKSWNJVHrR2mdbn-4YQfQenRJ9WkrtO-9HyTqtDL58ThB06pXPWcqN4jn5SJAtU_LJerglcIIXtGj1kvBQYmd1u6ciDMn7lJbefkimD7f1S5ERnGMX_VKvKc0lVzRQH5eszixxvFPelZLxMk35heKWnoBVkcEz0JmKrUfQzrR4_2M1xb5_pdNYAY9UjHevi5jjzARXhyxtRhHYAz2TKqQKTu_ffkCnaezXvxgp-g1Ka8ZNsPaAdwz0nRHdP4GwYtgUdo%3D)

[** DONATE TO CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c7bfb5b924264177b7d5d54fea6c2dec&_e=S3S57D_RtFBaZJDdllCl9g3gL0w4sHexScd_cBwWxf88ZK2Du3y-AHTpMO4yEWw07xZA4G0a028pw8kcA0yPI4Cer78urr-PNheGsKox--CTFWGi5w8OlqGzstSGI0mxpXQqxaluybZmKMGzG7HmP0uxqavimWcbKwF7u6-HKSWNJVHrR2mdbn-4YQfQenRJ9WkrtO-9HyTqtDL58ThB06pXPWcqN4jn5SJAtU_LJerglcIIXtGj1kvBQYmd1u6ciDMn7lJbefkimD7f1S5ERn5Rv8SustA3GPY5ZR32wLsPJd_OrLT8pgcrfF5h-eKcl-hTgaxCML1tdZz4X8s4li2ZY3SAIeAhMIm3u3totNxTHeWP4xa2Ym-k1WD0QS3WnbJvij6DG5o-9nkOl1KkAHoQYTP9xqMHCu61MicnnCo%3D)

We need a remedy for what Washington has been doing.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy or at least a good part of it.

Please join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

Kelsey Grammer

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

name: Chair Jaime Harrison (via Democrats.org)
subject: It’s National Voter Registration Day >>
body:
Take two minutes to check your voter registration status.
---
Folks, National Voter Registration Day is here! We hope you’ll use this message as a reminder to check your voter registration status and make your plan to vote. Tens of millions of Americans will vote in November’s election. Your voice and vote are integral to helping elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats across the country. I know you might be thinking, “I have voted in the past with no problems,” but I’m asking you to take just two minutes today to ensure your registration is up-to-date so that your vote can be counted. [**You can check your registration status at IWillVote.com:**](https://iwillvote.com/?state=na&partner=dnc_organizing&partner_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_vr_20240917_dnc_na_na_na_na&partner_medium=email&utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_vr_20240917_dnc_na_na_na_na&utm_medium=email?refcode=em_20240917_1403_do) **[CHECK YOUR REGISTRATION](https://iwillvote.com/?state=na&partner=dnc_organizing&partner_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_vr_20240917_dnc_na_na_na_na&partner_medium=email&utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_vr_20240917_dnc_na_na_na_na&utm_medium=email?refcode=em_20240917_1403_do)** Once you’ve confirmed your registration status and have made your plan to cast your ballot, take the time to make sure your loved ones and friends have theirs, too. This election is too important for any of us to sit on the sidelines. Thank you for all that you’re doing. Jaime Harrison
Chair
Democratic National Committee | [](https://iwillvote.com/?state=na&partner=dnc_organizing&partner_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_vr_20240917_dnc_na_na_na_na&partner_medium=email&utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_vr_20240917_dnc_na_na_na_na&utm_medium=email?refcode=em_20240917_1403_do&refcode2=1403.22930333.B7p7rI)

Peter,
Last week we told you that we were taking the Nevada lawsuit to the U.S. Supreme Court. We have some great news on that front, but first an update about another state. The anti-Democratic party is attempting to sue Jill and Butch off another ballot. **_This time New Hampshire._** We are sure we can prevail, our lawyers say it’s an easy win, but we will need to raise $20,000 for the battle. In this most recent lawfare from the anti-democratic party in New Hampshire, they assert that the petitioners incorrectly filled in the forms, but New Hampshire law clearly says that you can include your town OR your ward on the petition. Unsurprisingly, the majority of signers gave their town as most voters are unfamiliar with their ward. So what are they trying to use to subvert democracy this time? The failure of petition signers to note their ward! Signers were given a choice and the dirty Dems are still trying to deny voter choice by dragging us into yet another frivolous lawsuit that doesn’t hold water but drains Stein/Ware’s time and resources.

There are over one million registered voters in New Hampshire and they deserve to be able to vote for an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency administration this November. Peter,

Martin Heinrich has been in Washington, D.C. for a decade and a half, and he loves it.

Hi there—quick question, are you registered to vote? **Today is National Voter Registration Day, and we need to get out the vote to win this election.**
For months, our team has made mobilizing voters a top priority. This is a resource-heavy strategy, but with your help, we've been able to make significant ground in Utah. [**Can you chip in to help us continue to register voters throughout our state? >>**](https://king4ut.us/l/6hqZLCSUnYhx)
---
[ CHIP IN ](https://king4ut.us/l/NOmzf2KCfxC1)
---
We've reached out to a lot of people over the course of this campaign, and too many times we've heard folks say that they feel **_unheard and unrepresented_** in our government. **This is our chance to be heard.** Brian and Rebekah have inspired people to vote. They've made this campaign about more than just unseating Gov. Cox. They've made it about creating a better path forward for working families, for our children, for our environment, and for Utah—for the better. [**As a Democratic campaign in Utah, we MUST turn all the momentum that we've gained these past few months into action. Can you please make a grassroots contribution today and help us continue to register voters in Utah—to have our voices heard and win this election?**](https://king4ut.us/l/J6vQLkvU4A3x)
---
[ MAKE A GRASSROOTS CONTRIBUTION ](https://king4ut.us/l/j1rn6duvvsXb)

Thank you so much, Team Brian King

|

We'd hate to see you go, but to unsubscribe from future communications, [please click here.](https://king4ut.us/l/3xMdwxvugzQ9)
---
| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/Xs7W3ulLOCs0)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

Good Afternoon, Fellow Patriot, I have one simple question for you, but I want you to think long and hard about your answer because it may determine where we go as a nation.

**What does America mean to you, fellow American?**

**_This is my home, and it has given my family so much_.** That’s exactly why I joined the U.S. Military and served as an Explosive Ordinance Disposal (EOD) Officer while fighting in Afghanistan and Iraq.
