clean_body: | | | Good Afternoon, Fellow Patriot, I have one simple question for you, but I want you to think long and hard about your answer because it may determine where we go as a nation. What does America mean to you, fellow American? To me and my family, America means hope, freedom, and the promise of a better tomorrow. This nation took my family in when we were refugees escaping tyranny and death during the fall of Saigon. This is my home, and it has given my family so much. That’s exactly why I joined the U.S. Military and served as an Explosive Ordinance Disposal (EOD) Officer while fighting in Afghanistan and Iraq. I put my life on the line for this nation, and I would gladly do it again in a heartbeat. For the past 2 years, our rights have been stomped on and pushed to the side in favor of Left-Wing Radicalism that is out of touch with everyday Americans like you and me. The America I know and love would never push politics over people, and it certainly wouldn’t trample on our God-given rights. But that’s exactly what we’re facing with the radical liberals controlling Washington. Please, don’t stand by and watch them tear this nation apart, brick by brick. ********** I know it’s a big ask, but we cannot win back the Senate or get America back on track without help from Patriots like you, fellow American. So please don’t delay. Let me know if you’ll fight by my side as soon as you get this message. Thank you, CAPT Hung Cao, USN (Ret)Former Navy Special OperationsCandidate, U.S. Senate (VA) | TEXT HUNG TO 21412** Hung knows the American Dream is worth saving - because he’s lived it. Now, he’s running for Senate to defend it from the next generation. Hung Cao came to America with little besides the clothes on his back, and after his 25-year career in the Navy, he’s not done fighting for our future. body:
[1]Powered By People

I’ve been visiting college campuses around Texas for the past few weeks to
help register first-time voters, and I’ve gotta tell you: I’ve learned a
lot... including the “Apple Dance,” as taught to me by students at the
University of Texas in Arlington.

But this is part of meeting young people where they are, and learning what
they’re passionate about — and sometimes (right now, most of the time),
that includes Charli XCX.

This is also critical work: A spring 2024 poll by Harvard University
showed that 53% of voters under 30 will “definitely” be voting this year.
We’ve got to get those numbers up, and every single vote is going to make
a difference in November.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240917.MlwF7L&refcode=ema20240917-239815&t=1001&akid=239815%2E444211%2EebzX80 ]I’m going to talk to as many young voters as I can this fall, and Texas
is a big state — any chance you could chip in $3 for gas
money as I hit the road?

Here’s the thing: A recent article from the Texas Tribune highlighted how
Texas has the second youngest median age of any state — and in 2020, there
were about 1.3 million Texans ages 18 to 24 who were registered to vote.
Those voters have historically turned out to vote at rates lower than any
other age range, with voter participation rates increasing steadily as age
ranges increase.

So if Gen Z Texans came out to vote this November, we could make history.

donation of $3 or more would go a long way to help, can I
count on you?

Friend, At least once a month our team loves to give you opportunities to support impactful nonprofits that are doing important work in our communities. name: Sharice Davids
subject: Why I'm supporting Sarah McBride
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
I know that being someone who might just make history isn't enough to win.
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240917-1?refcode=em20240917-1-1222&refcode2=1222_21716_y6szNb&akid=1222%2E21716%2Ey6szNb)
Hi. It’s Representative Sharice Davids, and I’m writing to you on behalf of Sarah McBride.
As a former MMA fighter, I don't back down from a tough fight.
When I threw my hat in the ring to flip Kansas's 3rd congressional district in 2018, I'd never run for office before, and there had NEVER been a Native woman or openly LGBTQ+ Native American elected to Congress.
But we won that tough (and expensive) fight thanks to a surge of grassroots support from folks like you.
**So when Sarah McBride told me she was running to represent Delaware in the U.S. House, even though there's NEVER been an openly trans member of Congress, I told her, "Yes, you're running! And you're going to win!"**
Now, I know from running for office 4 times that being a bold fighter who might just make history isn't enough to win. You also have to raise money.
[**That's why I'm asking you to pitch in $5 (or whatever you can) between Sarah's campaign and mine. It takes millions to run for a House seat, and we rely on grassroots donors like you to raise the money we need to win.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240917-1?refcode=em20240917-1-1222&amount=5&refcode2=1222_21716_y6szNb&akid=1222%2E21716%2Ey6szNb)
**[Split a donation »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240917-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240917-1-1222&refcode2=1222_21716_y6szNb&akid=1222%2E21716%2Ey6szNb)**
I like how Sarah says, "I'm not running to be the first, I'm running to make a difference." I felt the same way whenever people asked about my identity as an LGBTQ+ Native woman on the campaign trail.
**And Sarah has proven she is _really_ good at making a difference.**
In her _first term_ in the Delaware legislature, she passed the state's landmark paid family and medical leave act — ensuring no Delawarean has to choose between paying for housing or taking care of a sick family member. She's also successfully fought for gun safety and to make Delaware a safe haven for reproductive care.
**Now, we both want to pass those same pro-family, pro-women, pro-working-people policies in the House. We just need a Democratic majority to get it done.**
[**Split a donation between our 2 campaigns to send a couple of bold fighters to the House who will champion your values each and every day.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240917-1?refcode=em20240917-1-1222&amount=5&refcode2=1222_21716_y6szNb&akid=1222%2E21716%2Ey6szNb)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240917-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240917-1-1222&refcode2=1222_21716_y6szNb&akid=1222%2E21716%2Ey6szNb)**
With gratitude,
Sharice
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20240917-1&t=1&refcode2=1222_21716_y6szNb&akid=1222%2E21716%2Ey6szNb)**

* [Update Your Information](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/update_your_information/?t=3&akid=1222%2E21716%2Ey6szNb)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=1222%2E21716%2Ey6szNb)

Hi friend, it's Carole King.
My friend Sherrod Brown is facing a tough reelection, and he needs ALL of us to pitch in. YOU have grassroots power, and together, we ARE grassroots power.

**[Will you join me in supporting Senator Brown with a donation of $5, or whatever you can afford?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93016020/499075367/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2953-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTc3Y2MyYi0zMDc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W-Re0IuBhAaguGP_6RyaQ5-W87R2xJ1F1bDx_uwmv-0=)**

**Here’s why Sherrod is worthy of your support. **
When I was growing up, my mom taught speech in public school, and my dad was a firefighter. They taught me the value of hard work, and most importantly, the Dignity of Work. Today, I’m still a proud member of three unions.
I’m inspired by Sherrod’s campaign because he's a proven champion for workers' rights. He’s spent his life in the trenches advocating for everything from higher wages to the right to unionize.
And Sherrod has always been a fearless leader at the forefront of protecting civil rights, LGBTQ+ rights, voting rights, and reproductive rights.

**Sherrod will always stand up for working families like the one in which I grew up. That’s why I’m asking you to use your grassroots power to make sure that a significant majority of Buckeye Staters turn out and vote to keep him in the U.S. Senate.**
[**Will you donate right now to keep our Dignity of Work champion Sherrod Brown in the U.S. Senate?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93016021/499075368/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2953-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTc3Y2MyYi0zMDc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W-Re0IuBhAaguGP_6RyaQ5-W87R2xJ1F1bDx_uwmv-0=)
Sherrod has run on these issues and won elections in the past, but Ohio has become increasingly challenging for a Democrat to win statewide. Sherrod is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection – and Ohio’s race for his seat could decide Senate control.
Friend, with Republicans getting millions of dollars from billionaires who pay less in taxes than American workers do, **grassroots power** is the most effective way to keep Sherrod Brown as our champion in the Senate and ensure that our hopes, our dreams, and our rights are the law of the land.
**[So please, will you join me RIGHT NOW in chipping in $5, or whatever you can afford, to reelect Sherrod in Ohio so he can continue fighting for working families across the country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93016022/499075369/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2953-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTc3Y2MyYi0zMDc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W-Re0IuBhAaguGP_6RyaQ5-W87R2xJ1F1bDx_uwmv-0=)**

Today, we celebrate the Constitution that made history and solidified the freedoms we are so fortunate to have in America today.

I know it can be easy sometimes, but I try my best to NEVER take these freedoms for granted - because I was born somewhere where people would do ANYTHING to have the opportunities we have in America today.

I came to our country from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell. I was only four years old, and my father was put on a kill list by the Viet Cong.

America welcomed us with open arms, and if it wasn’t for this country’s generosity, I may not be alive today.

That’s why I dedicated 25 years of my life to fighting for our great country in the U.S. Navy.

My story is living proof of the American Dream, and NONE of it would be possible without the freedoms our Constitution guarantees.

Now that the Democrat party is actively trying to trample these freedoms, I’m not about to sit on the sidelines.

**[I’m running for Senate to DEFEND our constitution against the radical Left. Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

**Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state._And I love this country._**

[**I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him, join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c7bc3fadfb3c4eea8c73ffd9ee08a732&_e=KmSTsclGsTAqc0oxMtZk_T68xgE0bIekavXIqI5hR13mCFHpr5WO9vLC241q7_RVwVur4WcVcZ3r11pP9s70uOW4cchwbq_jpqQzX-bEhEnl8xp2ReyKde6c1NYMQutmOTRf9f013RHMV1mmTTIbzUyZ5hA2DGZCUm5Auzi5qgO5LN1JQcGQ_lDtYqjiBHKKI18ZvGPr3EDhnBfKANdqpIIqqEb8YAG1M483Rkuj-1xqVesqJQyM_NXToruetrFciSM2pDkZMyuiaoTQiqbWCyaS8TW7Lv_xYYwsoM3_MK8qOHkOIp-EnowaUgev_yGPcnRyK_UPqX_gcUfIzPUhzsbmKYuJBLFaTo2_oa6W-qpMdTK_fpL-6XEcOe6shvrd0S39CQXmKO-R_SJDT5y5gDRUmLMz_ytSqcHHSe5aznY%3D)

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so-called “community” was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, on a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: _Hatred and Racism._ **Pathetic**.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

[**I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c7bc3fadfb3c4eea8c73ffd9ee08a732&_e=KmSTsclGsTAqc0oxMtZk_T68xgE0bIekavXIqI5hR13mCFHpr5WO9vLC241q7_RVwVur4WcVcZ3r11pP9s70uOW4cchwbq_jpqQzX-bEhEnl8xp2ReyKde6c1NYMQutmOTRf9f013RHMV1mmTTIbzUyZ5hA2DGZCUm5Auzi5qgO5LN1JQcGQ_lDtYqjiBHKKI18ZvGPr3EDhnBfKANdqpIIqqEb8YAG1M483Rkuj-1xqVesqJQyM_NXToruetrFciSM2pDkZMyuiaoTQiqbWC0QcUjxuJAYchJyd9WFDCHL13px8x6NrhTqW5Hk2LijQKoVovUU3qFuPkOPOITtcU77ZtlgncLTQ6TxDkyjmI2Jed_Gc2pgRJziHCmDxB9AfFpmxyTkKRHHzukuHz0Fac4ELdqTyDywvlicjbhSnBHc%3D)

We can look to him to promote prosperity for all—a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States. Our Constitution.

[**There comes a time when we have to speak out in support of our nation’s traditional values. For Patriotism. For the right to pursue happiness on our own terms.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c7bc3fadfb3c4eea8c73ffd9ee08a732&_e=KmSTsclGsTAqc0oxMtZk_T68xgE0bIekavXIqI5hR13mCFHpr5WO9vLC241q7_RVwVur4WcVcZ3r11pP9s70uOW4cchwbq_jpqQzX-bEhEnl8xp2ReyKde6c1NYMQutmOTRf9f013RHMV1mmTTIbzUyZ5hA2DGZCUm5Auzi5qgO5LN1JQcGQ_lDtYqjiBHKKI18ZvGPr3EDhnBfKANdqpIIqqEb8YAG1M483Rkuj-1xqVesqJQyM_NXToruetrFciSM2pDkZMyuiaoTQiqbWC6l1lUJgeE78n-xMYvPH0PGG3wdXoudP-Jn4PRb6ojyLk3k0XCm-UXU9fOfqYJc2_B_A1Ea80a8Y219QoiU9sLN67TEFpHqPmYViYdy7Q9wbFly3eZKgMNQ1PHz5AMunmh2-OuUhbAo9mcCIJ5f-Hsw%3D)

[** DONATE TO CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c7bc3fadfb3c4eea8c73ffd9ee08a732&_e=KmSTsclGsTAqc0oxMtZk_T68xgE0bIekavXIqI5hR13mCFHpr5WO9vLC241q7_RVwVur4WcVcZ3r11pP9s70uOW4cchwbq_jpqQzX-bEhEnl8xp2ReyKde6c1NYMQutmOTRf9f013RHMV1mmTTIbzUyZ5hA2DGZCUm5Auzi5qgO5LN1JQcGQ_lDtYqjiBHKKI18ZvGPr3EDhnBfKANdqpIIqqEb8YAG1M483Rkuj-1xqVesqJQyM_NXToruetrFciSM2pDkZMyuiaoTQiqbWC-_V2ep5ZH6TtLS9soDszRkZdatBF871tOkMjiPGX1hCCZKg2wXtRwqNGeKCnOgBF3qNWsM5UjUbanMaFG-I1eL1WIG2wVxZzva4DCFaNKN0_H3quYJ5n3QhXwr48c1HdGvPG3qi1AWir_qi3u9rYJM%3D)

We need a remedy for what Washington has been doing.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy or at least a good part of it.

Please join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

Kelsey Grammer

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. **Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

subject: An issue of extreme concern

body:
For years, VoteVets has run ads. Television ads, digital ads, radio ads. Millions and millions of dollars worth. You name it, we’ve run it.
#
Peter, this is Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, retired.
**YouTube is refusing to allow VoteVets to promote my video explaining Donald Trump’s Project 2025,** and what it would mean for the United States Military.
[**And right now, I am asking you to make a donation to VoteVets so that we have the resources we need to ensure this message is heard loud and clear — even without the use of one of the largest online platforms available to us.](https://act.votevets.org/go/3042?c0=vv-pac-em-sep24-project2025.4GM_aL&refcode=em240917-1-30&t=1&akid=30024%2E3013755%2Etnxz3d)**
| [CONTRIBUTE](https://act.votevets.org/go/3042?c0=vv-pac-em-sep24-project2025.4GM_aL&refcode=em240917-1-30&t=2&akid=30024%2E3013755%2Etnxz3d)
---
A word about why this video being blacklisted on YouTube is such a blow to our overall strategy, and why your help is so essential at this moment:
Before every campaign it is critical to appraise your core competencies, and what tools and resources are available to you to accomplish your mission.
VoteVets focuses almost exclusively on Veterans issues and National Security, and the broader implications of politics on the Military at large. It is a competency that no other organization on our side of the aisle fills. It falls to us to make arguments that others do not and often cannot make, because we speak directly to Veterans and Military Families.
As I mentioned, YouTube is one of the largest online platforms available to us. With mis- and disinformation proliferating online and bad actors multiplying, we use paid advertising on YouTube to level the playing field and ensure our messages are heard. Over the years we have spent millions and millions of dollars on advertising, and a large part of that has been on YouTube.
That is, until now. YouTube has refused to allow us to promote a video I personally helped produce about one of the core, unifying principles of a second Trump administration — Project 2025. In short, Trump would turn the United States Military into a personal armed guard through Project 2025. Today, the Military is loyal first and foremost to the Constitution. Under Project 2025, Trump intends to impose a posture of loyalty to himself first and foremost. It would probably destroy the fabric of our Military command relationships.
This is an important issue to me, personally, and it is essential that the American people hear about it. But YouTube won’t allow us to use their platform to do it. So, we’ve got to reassess our strategy. That takes time — and additional resources.
This late in the campaign, something like this can have a serious impact. So, I am humbly asking for your support as we pursue other avenues to spread this message.
[**Make a $5 donation to VoteVets today and we will direct every dollar into ensuring the public knows about Trump’s radical agenda. Together we can prevent Project 2025 from coming to pass, and defeat Donald Trump — once, and for all.](https://act.votevets.org/go/3042?c0=vv-pac-em-sep24-project2025.4GM_aL&refcode=em240917-1-30&t=3&akid=30024%2E3013755%2Etnxz3d)**

Dear fellow American, Time magazine published a story featuring the headline, "The Free Market is Dead: What Will Replace It?"

This is, of course, an exaggeration, but it makes clear the far-Left's goal--nothing less than a transformation of the world economy based on a rejection of economist Adam Smith's "invisible hand."

As the author writes, "We are on the cusp of a new era of broad-based prosperity in which our leaders are poised to more actively manage the American market."

Today's advocates of a "managed market" may call it by a new name--"The Great Reset"--but it is premised on an old and harmful idea.

What utopian ideologies like this one have in common is a misplaced faith in the rule of so-called experts and a corresponding disregard for the people's right to rule themselves. Taken to their logical conclusion, such ideologies can end only in **tyranny**.

The great British statesman Winston Churchill knew this, which led him to observe, "Nothing would be more fatal than for the government of states to get into the hands of the experts. Expert knowledge is limited knowledge: and the unlimited ignorance of the plain man who knows only what hurts is a safer guide, than any vigorous direction of a specialised character."

**In the fight to preserve our freedom, our greatest asset is education.** Americans who understand our country's founding principles and have a firm grasp of history are best prepared to resist the lure of utopian schemes.

**[That's why Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in our FREE MARKET SURVEY.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)**

Your answers will help us understand more clearly the views of mainstream Americans--not the so-called experts--concerning the importance of the free market system in our nation.

Please begin your survey below. Your answers will remain strictly confidential.

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/free-market-survey/](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)**

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

clean_body: Ready to make history? | One of the most powerful lessons I’ve learned through years of organizing is that real climate victories often begin in the races that don’t make national headlines. It’s in those smaller state and local races where winning the fight for our planet begins. That’s why we’re doing things a little differently today. I’m starting my Climate Champs of the Week series! Every week, I’m going to introduce you to a few of the boldest, JanePAC-endorsed candidates who are fighting to turn the tide on climate in their communities. And this week, we’re heading to Arizona, where three incredible candidates are ready to shake things up. With these endorsements, we have a historic opportunity to elect a pro-climate majority to the state legislature and undo years of damage caused by corporate polluters. = | = = First up, we have Judy Schwiebert, running for the Arizona State Senate in Legislative District 2. Judy is a current state representative, lifelong educator, mom, and community leader who’s spent decades preparing Arizona’s kids for the future. Now, she’s taking action, fighting for water protection, air quality, repealing the ban on monitoring greenhouse gas emissions, and a healthier future for Arizona’s families. With her work in the Arizona State House already making a difference, Judy’s now running in a key swing district for the Senate. Her victory could be the key to building a pro-climate Senate majority, and her experience makes her the ideal person to lead the charge to protect Arizona’s natural resources. = = Next on the list is John McLean, running for the Arizona State Senate in Legislative District 17. John’s story is one of deep roots — he’s a third-generation Arizonan who’s dedicated his life to building up his community, advocating for the environment, and pushing the boundaries of innovation. What’s John bringing to the table? A fierce determination to tackle Arizona’s water crisis head-on. LD17 is a competitive district, and John’s background in both business and public service perfectly positions him to lead the charge on smart water management. He’s seen what happens when leadership sells out to foreign corporations, and he’s not about to let Arizona’s water get drained for profits. John’s race is critical — and his vision for a secure, sustainable Arizona is exactly what we need to turn the tide. = = And then we have Stephanie Simacek, running for the Arizona House of Representatives in Legislative District 2. Stephanie’s story is one of resilience and service. She’s a teacher, a mom, and a fierce advocate for her community, but what really sets her apart is her unwavering commitment to addressing Arizona’s water and environmental crises. As a mother, she’s fighting for our children’s future, and as a public servant, she’s pushing for solutions that put conservation, sustainability, and innovation front and center for all Arizonans. In a tight race like this one, Stephanie’s leadership could be the key to flipping the House and securing a pro-climate majority. = These three candidates are fighting for the future of Arizona — and the planet. They’re up against entrenched interests and corporate polluters, and they need our support to get across the finish line. = Stay tuned for next week’s edition! -Jane Fonda = | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. body:
It’s National Voter Registration Day! Peter,

Today is National Voter Registration Day, and with the November election fast approaching, **now is the time to ensure you’re registered to vote and ready to make your voice heard.**

The stakes this November couldn’t be higher. This isn’t just another election – _it’s about shaping the future of our country for generations to come._ As Americans, we have a responsibility to exercise our constitutional right to use our voices not just for ourselves – **but also to protect our friends, loved ones, and neighbors.**

Here are three things you can do today to ensure you’re prepared for November:

1\. **Check your voter registration status.** Even if you think you’re registered, it doesn’t hurt to double-check. You can do that [**here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93020982/499090754/553517634?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDkxMDUwMDktM2M3NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=EZu1IgXXOaWtTYXTaSGB0MISB_2Zf6CcwjTmqjehLLU=&emci=c275f3ea-1e75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=09105009-3c75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1020964) The deadline to register to vote in Missouri is October 9, 2024 – so don’t wait!

2\. **Register to vote or update your registration.** If it’s your first time voting or if you’ve moved, you can register to vote [**here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93020988/499090761/1422668303?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDkxMDUwMDktM2M3NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=EZu1IgXXOaWtTYXTaSGB0MISB_2Zf6CcwjTmqjehLLU=&emci=c275f3ea-1e75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=09105009-3c75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1020964) It only takes a few minutes.

3\. **Forward this email to three friends.** Too many people miss their chance to vote because they didn’t register in time. Let’s make sure that doesn’t happen this year.

Let’s be clear: The decisions we make this November will shape our future. Women's rights, action on climate change, and programs like Social Security and Medicare are all on the line. Extremists are hell-bent on taking us backward to the dark ages, **and we need to fight back.**

So, if you haven’t registered yet, now’s the time. It takes just a few minutes to get ready to vote in November. Every vote matters – _don’t sit this one out!_ | [REGISTER TO VOTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93020993/499090767/1422668303?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDkxMDUwMDktM2M3NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=EZu1IgXXOaWtTYXTaSGB0MISB_2Zf6CcwjTmqjehLLU=&emci=c275f3ea-1e75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=09105009-3c75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1020964)

clean_body: It’s National Voter Registration Day! Peter, Today is National Voter Registration Day, and with the November election fast approaching, now is the time to ensure you’re registered to vote and ready to make your voice heard. The stakes this November couldn’t be higher. This isn’t just another election – it’s about shaping the future of our country for generations to come. As Americans, we have a responsibility to exercise our constitutional right to use our voices not just for ourselves – but also to protect our friends, loved ones, and neighbors. Here are three things you can do today to ensure you’re prepared for November: 1\. Check your voter registration status. Even if you think you’re registered, it doesn’t hurt to double-check. You can do that The deadline to register to vote in Missouri is October 9, 2024 – so don’t wait! 2\. Register to vote or update your registration. If it’s your first time voting or if you’ve moved, you can register to vote It only takes a few minutes. 3\. Forward this email to three friends. Too many people miss their chance to vote because they didn’t register in time. Let’s make sure that doesn’t happen this year. Let’s be clear: The decisions we make this November will shape our future. Women's rights, action on climate change, and programs like Social Security and Medicare are all on the line. Extremists are hell-bent on taking us backward to the dark ages, and we need to fight back. So, if you haven’t registered yet, now’s the time. | Peter,
After the Constitution was signed on this day in 1787, Elizabeth Willing Powels asked Benjamin Franklin, “Well, Doctor, what have we got, a republic or a monarchy?” to which he replied, “A republic, if you can keep it.” Now it is our turn to make sure we keep it. That starts with an educated vote.

ACTION STEPS:
#1 Research each candidate and understand what their policies would mean for our country. Personalities are less important than what they would actually do in office.

#2 Vote (by mail, early voting, or on Election Day).

#3 Encourage your family, friends, and neighbors to research first, then to vote.

#4 Support candidates who will protect our Constitution, who will honor the Rule of Law, and who will make sure it is applied equally to all people. The candidates need to know and respect the people and communities that they are running to represent.

repeat them on social media, news outlets, and at rallies.

Georgia is one of the nine states in America that implements a **“use it or lose it”** policy, meaning if you haven’t used your right to vote, your name could be _purged_ from the voter rolls.

_Even worse,_ you may have _no idea_ your name was removed until you show up at the polls, _only_ to be turned away or forced to use a provisional ballot.

In 2017, over 100,000 voters went through this process, being dropped from the voter rolls due to “inactivity” and never finding out until it was too late to change it.

**But we won’t let this be our reality. Here at Team Butler, when it comes to the right to vote, we’re all about _using it and keeping it._

subject: Help Us Push for the Farm Bill – Support Our Farmers
body:

| | | |
---
| | | **Help Us Push for the Farm Bill – **
**Support Our Farmers**
---

Dear Peter,
As we enter a critical moment for our nation’s farmers, the need for Congress to pass the Farm Bill this month has never been more urgent. Washington’s 8th Congressional District is home to hardworking farmers and ranchers who are the backbone of our local economy. They depend on this vital legislation to ensure they have the resources, support, and stability needed to continue feeding our communities.
Congress has until September 30th to act and reauthorize the bill. Kim Schrier has been ineffective in supporting our farmers or moving this bill forward. It’s time we have a proactive Congresswoman working for our community.
Our campaign is committed to standing up for our farmers and ensuring that the Farm Bill passes this month. But we can’t do it alone—we need your support.

---
| | | |
---
| Your donation will help us continue to advocate for the agricultural policies that protect our way of life and keep our economy strong.
Whether you can contribute $25, $50, or any amount, your support is crucial. Together, we can make sure Washington’s 8th District has the leadership it needs to get the Farm Bill passed and protect our farmers.

---

Sincerely,
Team Goers

name: John Fetterman
subject: Meet the Frontline Five
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
[1]Fetterman's Frontline Five

Derek, I refuse to
believe that we will lose the Senate this year. 🙅♂️

The GOP is spending millions of dollars to unseat five of my colleagues
and return Mitch McConnell the majority. They are hoping to flip seats in
Nevada, Montana, Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, and my home state,
Pennsylvania. And with those wins, Republicans plan to take back control
of the U.S. Senate. Not on my watch.

If we are going to deliver stability, unity, and a new way forward with
Kamala Harris, we will need to defend our Democratic Senate majority. It’s
a feat that won’t be possible without the re-election of what I am calling
my Frontline Five:

Bob Casey
Jon Tester
Jacky Rosen
Sherrod Brown
Tammy Baldwin

So far this cycle, we have raised over $75,000 for these critical races
thanks to supporters like you – but there is so much more that we need to
do to make sure these Senators win their elections and return to a blue
Senate, + Election Day is rapidly approaching!

That’s why: I am setting a goal to raise $150,000 for the Frontline Five
by the end of the third quarter (September 30th at midnight). This
infusion of support will help these campaigns meet their end-of-quarter
goals AND provide much-needed support to fight off attacks from the GOP
and its super PACs.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240917?refcode=em20240917-FFF-9392&refcode2=9392_434096_92AzWg&akid=9392%2E434096%2E92AzWg ][IMG]

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240917?refcode=em20240917-FFF-9392&refcode2=9392_434096_92AzWg&akid=9392%2E434096%2E92AzWg ]Derek, will
you rush a $5 contribution to the Frontline Five and get us
one step closer to keeping a blue Senate? We have less than halfway to go
to reach our $150,000 goal and get these Democratic candidates over the
line!

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240917?amount=5&refcode=em20240917-FFF-9392&refcode2=9392_434096_92AzWg&akid=9392%2E434096%2E92AzWg ]Donate $5 »

I don’t have to tell you how much is at stake in this election. Keeping a
blue Senate is paramount to delivering on the issues that matter most to
Americans:

✅ Securing access to abortion
✅ Codifying LGBTQ+ rights
✅ Passing the voting rights act
✅ Voting through liberal SCOTUS nominations
✅ Approving Kamala Harris’ Cabinet picks
✅ and so much more...

None of this is possible if we lose the Senate in November. Every donation
you make to a Fetterman’s Frontline Five email will go directly to each of
the five key Senate races needed to defend our Senate Majority.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240917?refcode=em20240917-FFF-9392&refcode2=9392_434096_92AzWg&akid=9392%2E434096%2E92AzWg ]So, I have to ask,
Derek: will you take action
RIGHT NOW to help defend the Frontline Five and our Democratic Senate
Majority by making a $5 contribution right now?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240917?amount=5&refcode=em20240917-FFF-9392&refcode2=9392_434096_92AzWg&akid=9392%2E434096%2E92AzWg ]Donate »

This election is too important to sit on the sidelines. I hope you’ll join
me in supporting my Frontline Five and defending our majority at this
pivotal moment.

💙 John

John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

Team — Donald Trump was in California for a high-dollar fundraiser, and he took the opportunity to attack his least favorite Californian — yours truly. And to cast doubt on our election, saying that my opponent will win if it’s an honest election. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51819?t=7&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd) _“You have one of the sleaziest politicians in history,**crooked Adam Schiff**. He’s one of the **most disgusting human beings** , and to think he’s going to be a Senator. That’s why you need me as President. **Because this guy is a sleazebag.** Adam Schiff, to represent this area, is impossible to believe.”_ [**No, Donald — what’s impossible to believe is that you are running again after your calamitous term in office and multiple crimes. Team, help me respond to him right away. Rush in a split donation of $10 between Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats and my campaign so we can stand up to Trump’s attacks on our home turf and defeat him.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51819?t=8&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51820?t=9&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51821?t=10&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)

[Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51819?t=13&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)
Team, this is just another of a dozen attacks Trump has thrown my way.

“Watermelon head,” “Pencil neck,” “Fat ugly face,” “Shifty Schiff,” the list goes on.

But that wasn’t all. He also cast doubt on California elections, saying that my opponent, Steve Garvey, would win if we had an honest election. There he goes again — setting up another big lie for when he and Garvey lose.

_Heck, if he spent half the time he does on big lies and insults, he might have more than just “concepts of plans” to talk about on the campaign trail!_

But he doesn’t. Because this is classic Donald Trump. All flash and entertainment, insults and attacks to get another cable news hit — with no substance or plans to deliver for the people of California.

And these relentless attacks on me are a part of his campaign strategy to win in November. **Trump and his enablers focus their attacks on me because they know that no one has been more effective at holding him accountable for his lies and misdeeds, and nothing infuriates his supporters more than the reminder of how I stood up to him.**

In the House, I impeached him and served on the Select Committee on the January 6 Attack. **In the Senate, I’ll keep fighting his assaults on our democracy and hold his biggest enablers accountable.**

His obsession is the highest compliment — _it means I’m doing my job._
[**I’ll always stand up to Trump and anyone who attacks our democracy. But for us to respond before their vicious lies take hold, I need your support. Please, friend, I need you to pitch in a split donation between my campaign and Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats. We have a big FEC fundraising deadline at the end of the month, and we’re susceptible to Trump and his MAGA movement attacking us again if we fall short of our goals.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51819?t=14&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51820?t=15&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51821?t=16&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51822?t=17&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51823?t=18&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51819?t=19&akid=22086%2E4449941%2E9RhUfd)
With Trump mentioning that he hears my GOP opponent, Steve Garvey, wants the MAGA endorsement, and Garvey already airing millions of dollars in TV ads across our state, we need the resources to respond right away. I’m counting on you.

Thanks,
Adam

We promise this isn’t an exaggeration, Peter.
There are just two weeks until the biggest fundraising deadline of this campaign.
At the end of every quarter, our campaign legally has to report how much we’ve raised. Those numbers go public, and everyone — from our opponent to Mike Johnson’s super PAC — can see them. These deadlines are critical for showing that we’ve raised enough to take on outside spending and win this frontline race.
But here’s the kicker: September is our last end-of-quarter deadline before the election. This is our last chance to show how incredible the grassroots support behind this campaign is. We haven’t missed a goal yet — but we’ve never set one this high.
This is one of the most flippable seats in the whole country, and you can be sure that Republican mega-donors will be watching it closely.

| Peter,

I want to ensure you are informed about North Carolina’s new voter identification laws as we approach early voting and Election Day!

_**You will be turned away from the polls or have to file a provisional ballot if you do not have an acceptable photo ID on hand.**_ Your vote is extremely important, and we cannot take a single one for granted.

__Acceptable photo IDs include:__
---
|
* Driver’s license
* U.S. Passport or Passport Card
* State Issued ID
* Military or Veteran ID Card

|
* Student ID (if approved by County Board)
* Charter school or Government employee ID
* Tribal Enrollment Card
* Public Assistance Program ID Card

---|---
_*If you are 65 years or older, an expired ID will work as long as it was un-expired on your 65th birthday*_

**If you do not have one of the above photo IDs, you can get a FREE NC voter photo ID Card from the County Board of Elections here: [_https://www.ncsbe.gov/voting/voter-id/get-free-voter-photo-id_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93022740/499096543/490381824?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzEzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMTkwZTI2Mi00MDc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=82AQ-OQl5APJSrLMWPeFgqPZPpCnr33V2A_Uf14_7G8=&emci=b390e262-4075-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=c190e262-4075-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=20329070)**

name: Justin Kwasa, LCV
subject: It’s National Voter Registration Day!
body:
Check your registration and spread the word.

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE1MTgyMDkS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjA2MDM2MjA5MQS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
|
* * *
---
| | | | Dear Peter,
---
| | While this is a democracy, ensuring that our electoral outcomes reflect the will of the American people requires making sure that as many of those people as possible are able to participate at the ballot box as registered voters.
---
| | That’s why LCV is a proud partner and supporter of National Voter Registration Day, the nation’s largest civic holiday with more than 5 million voter registrations to its name since 2012.
---
| | Here’s how YOU can celebrate democracy today:
---
| |
* **Register to vote or check your registration** online using [**_our online vote planning tools._**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/4L4XBd9dARM-) Even if online voter registration is not available in your state, you can easily start the process online no matter where you live.

Can you pitch in on this special day?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93023767/499099922/801713560?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20240917_f_NationalVoterRegistrationDay_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhN2MwNGYwNS00NDc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k5UrsFl_YaivG_HCzX3h3ib20LRohUL2xWgG7umN6V0=) Not only is National Voter Registration Day an important reminder of a crucial part of our democratic process, it’s a chance for thousands of voters to commit to taking action for their communities. body:
| | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240917_guard_the_vote&n=1)
---
Friend -- Today, September 17, is Constitution Day! On this day in 1787, 39 courageous men ratified the United States Constitution. My hero, Alexander Hamilton, represented the State of New York. Today, we have a government that is more beholden to big money interests than the principles set forth in that document. Our Congressmen and Senators are particularly corrupt, and are very difficult to remove, thanks to unlimited amounts of dark money pouring into their campaigns, as well as what one might politely refer to as "election irregularities." We need to protect our electoral process! I am launching an initiative in New York State called, "Guard the Vote." I need volunteers in each of the 62 counties to participate in everything from inspecting the voting machines, to poll watching, to monitoring the results online as they are posted. You can even help with the online part of this from out of state. Please take 12 minutes to watch the video below, which documents my amazing disappearing vote when I ran against Schumer in 2022. It concludes with a list of things that we need volunteers to do. After you watch the video (or even before) please click the box under the video to volunteer in your county or online. We will schedule a Zoom meeting with volunteers across the state early next week to answer questions. The inspection of voting machines begins in the last days of September, depending on your county, so sign up today![](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=XCQjXK2gfZavpXeHUbAHDOE9b7udc8hLWXIXxeNykBUm4JssOZECWOUMfukpL91H&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240917_guard_the_vote&n=2) | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/guard_the_vote?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240917_guard_the_vote&n=3 "I want to volunteer to Guard the Vote") [I want to volunteer to Guard the Vote](https://www.sareforsenate.com/guard_the_vote?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240917_guard_the_vote&n=3)

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: If you know a farmer, a veteran, or a senior—read this.
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Whether you realize it or not, you know someone who’s been hurt by Jim Jordan’s reckless votes – and you can help stop his attacks on the people in your life.
If you know a farmer , tell them Jordan has voted against every single Farm Bill that helps keep our agricultural industry strong.
He’s turned his back on Ohio’s farmers, leaving them to struggle while big corporations thrive.
If you know a Veteran , tell them Jordan voted against the PACT Act, which provides healthcare for Afghanistan Veterans exposed to toxic burn pits and Vietnam Veterans exposed to agent orange.
While Jordan claims to support the troops, he’s left our heroes behind when it mattered most.
If you know a senior , tell them Jordan wants to raise the retirement age, he voted against lowering prescription costs, he voted against $35 Insulin, and he has been fighting to cut Social Security.
For decades, hard-working Ohioans have paid into Social Security, relying on it for retirement. But Jordan is more concerned with pushing his extreme agenda than protecting your money and the benefits you’ve earned.
We’re still short of our $1 million fundraising goal this month, and we need your help to get there. Chip in now, and together, we can expose Jim Jordan’s voting record and ensure Ohioans know the truth about his attacks on our families. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240917_if_you_know_link1]
If you know a survivor of sexual abuse , remind them of Jordan’s scandalous history with Ohio State University.
He ignored cries for help while young men suffered abuse at the hands of their doctor.
Do we really want someone like him making decisions that affect us all?
If you know a teacher , tell them Jordan has voted against funding for public schools time and time again.
While our educators work tirelessly to shape the future of our children, Jordan’s votes prove he’d rather see them underpaid and overworked.
The list goes on and on...
From his constant attacks on women’s rights to undercutting food assistance for hungry children, to pushing cuts to Social Security and Medicare – nearly every American has been hurt by Jim Jordan’s politics, and it’s up to ALL OF US to stop him .
This is the most important congressional race in the nation.
Jim Jordan’s dangerous, ULTRA-MAGA fueled agenda isn’t just bad for Ohio—it’s a threat to our entire country.
We can’t afford to let him stay in power.
We’re so close to our goal, and every contribution brings us one step closer to defeating Jim Jordan and sending real leadership to Congress. Donate now to help us reach our $1 million goal, and let’s take back the House. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240917_if_you_know_link2]
Let’s show Jordan what true American values look like: integrity, compassion, and leadership that works for everyone.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/Screenshot%202023-08-30%20at%2012.16.45%20PM.jpeg]
Donate to Tamie Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240917_if_you_know_button]
Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

| | | Peter, As we enter the final sprint to Election Day, the pace of events is fast and furious. It’s easy to get swept up in the chaos, but now more than ever, we need to ground ourselves in our work and our movement’s vision for the future. It’s easy to get swept up in the chaos, but now more than ever, we need to ground ourselves in our work and our movement’s vision for the future. We’re inviting you to a Mass Call to reflect, process, and learn together. This call will give us the space to step back, understand the bigger picture, and remember why we do this work. We’ll examine current events, not through the lens of punditry, but by placing this election in the context of our long-term goals for structural change. This is more than just the road to November — it’s the long march for freedom. On this call, we’ll hear from activists on the frontlines like artist and WFP member Patrisse Cullors; Vice President of the Chicago Teachers Union Jackson Potter; co-founder of We Are Revolutionary Luckee Forbes; and our very own WFP Philadelphia City Councilmember Kendra Brooks. They will share the critical work they are doing in this election — and what YOU can do to play your part. Together, we’ll reflect on the actions we’re taking now, not just for this election, but to build a movement and a working class voting electorate capable of real change. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: My op-ed: What Donald Trump Isn’t Telling Us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2346%2E4032634%2Ep07t8Y

One of the more memorable parts of last week’s debate was Trump’s “I have
concepts of a plan” quip after being asked about his approach to
healthcare.

And the idea of a presidential candidate not having policy plans would be
laughable if this sinister strategy wasn’t behind it.

You see, they do have a plan on health care. The problem is just that when
they publicly declare those plans, they horrify voters.

I wrote an op-ed for the New York Times about Trump’s actual health care
plans and why we can’t let this evasion strategy slide. Please read it
below. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2694?amount=25&t=1006&akid=2346%2E4032634%2Ep07t8Y ]And if you’re able, please chip in
$25 or
anything you can to power our work to make the MAGA movement’s hypocrisy
loud and clear to voters and protect access to health care in our country.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Elizabeth Warren: What Donald Trump Isn’t Telling Us

During the presidential debate on Tuesday, Donald Trump was pressed on the
details of his plan to repeal Obamacare and replace it with something
“better.” The question should’ve been a softball. After all, Mr. Trump has
been promising the American people a plan for nine years, so he’s had time
to prepare. His answer? After ducking and weaving, he came up with: “I
have concepts of a plan.” Uh, that’s not a plan.

Plans translate values into action. They test the quality of the ideas and
the seriousness of the people advancing them. Plans reveal for whom
candidates will fight and how effective they are likely to be. And in a
presidential race, if either party’s nominee is asked about his or her
plans for something as fundamental as health care, voters should get a
straight answer.

The problem is not that Mr. Trump can’t think up a way to put his values
into action. The problem is that when he and other Republican leaders
produce plans with actual details, they horrify the American people.

Mr. Trump’s health care values have been on full display for years. In
2017, Republicans controlled Congress, and their first major legislative
undertaking was a bill to repeal the Affordable Care Act. Every time they
drafted something, independent experts would point out that their plan
would toss tens of millions of people off their health insurance, jack up
premium costs and slash benefits for those with ongoing health problems.

After months of wrangling, Mr. Trump and Republican lawmakers voted a bill
through the House to repeal the A.C.A. That night, Mr. Trump hosted a
party at the White House to celebrate their big step toward taking away
health care from millions of people.

A.C.A. repeal then moved to the Senate. Republicans had the majority, so
if they all stuck with Mr. Trump, the A.C.A. would die. As senators
gathered to vote, nearly all of the Democrats — including Kamala Harris,
then a senator from California — remained standing, too anxious even to
sit down. We murmured stories about who would be affected by this vote:
the uncle who had cancer and would lose coverage, the kid diagnosed with a
heart anomaly whose parents wouldn’t be able to find new insurance, the
college students who would just go without coverage and hope they didn’t
fall on ice or get in a car accident. We felt the weight of people’s lives
on the line.

As the votes rolled in, we could see that Mr. Trump was on track to win.
Our last hope was John McCain. When Mr. McCain put his thumb down, he
saved the Affordable Care Act. That one vote made the difference for
millions of Americans between losing and keeping their health care
coverage.

Over time, people have decided that they like the access to health care
that the A.C.A. gives them. Republican losses in 2018 and 2020 are often
attributed in part to Mr. Trump’s efforts to take away the A.C.A.
Republican members of Congress have since smartened up and stopped talking
about repeal.

Mr. Trump, however, was unbowed. He doubled down on getting rid of the
A.C.A., saying last year that it “sucks,” and that Republicans should
“never give up” on repealing it.

But at the debate, Mr. Trump displayed a new strategy. He seems to realize
that his health-care plans are deeply unpopular, so he simply doesn’t talk
about them. Thus, after nine years of railing against the A.C.A. and
trying mightily to repeal it, he has moved to “concepts of a plan,”
without a single detail that anyone can pin him down on.

The new strategy might have worked — except Mr. Trump’s right-wing buddies
have already laid out the plans. No need for concepts. Project 2025 has
920 pages translating Republican values into detailed action plans,
including on health care: Repeal the A.C.A. Cut Medicare benefits. End $35
insulin. Stop Medicare drug price negotiations. Cut health-care access for
poor families. Restrict contraceptive care. Jeopardize access to I.V.F.
Ban medication abortion.

As Project 2025’s favorability plummets, Mr. Trump is once again
scrambling. “I have nothing to do with Project 2025,” he claimed at the
debate. “I’m not going to read it.” But it was written by many members of
Mr. Trump’s former administration and over 250 of the policies in the plan
match his past or current policy proposals.

While Mr. Trump dances around “concepts of a plan” that will rip away
health care access for millions, Vice President Harris and Democrats in
Congress are committed to real improvements. We’ve already delivered
Medicare price negotiation on 10 widely used drugs, capped monthly insulin
costs at $35 for seniors and limited out-of-pocket spending for
prescription drugs under Medicare to $2,000 per year. In Ms. Harris’s
first big economic speech last month, she announced she’d build on these
wins, extending access to $35-per-month insulin to all Americans and
allowing Medicare to negotiate prices for even more drugs. She has also
called for ensuring abortion access nationwide.

A presidential campaign should be, in part, a debate of ideas, and it’s
not only reasonable but also commendable that people want to know what a
person would do in office. That’s why Ms. Harris has given major policy
addresses and released a slew of policy proposals, including a plan this
week focusing on rural America. Mr. Trump should be held to the same
expectation. The reason there isn’t more outcry over his debate answer is
that we all know his actual plan: Get elected, and then do whatever the
far right wants with the A.C.A. But saying that out loud wouldn’t go over
well at a debate.

As Ms. Harris has pointed out, Mr. Trump is not a serious man, and
“concepts of a plan” is a silly dodge. But, as she also noted, a Trump
presidency would have profoundly serious consequences — including
life-or-death outcomes for millions of people who could lose access to
health care. When voters mark their ballots, they may consider that a man
with Mr. Trump’s record cannot be trusted with our families’ health care.

| | Voting is the heart of our democracy, and it is the most powerful tool we have for ensuring continued progress and upholding the core ideals of our nation's founders. [**Today – on National Voter Registration Day – I want to encourage everyone to check whether their voter registration is up to date.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93025967/499106945/1364077512?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMmIwNmY2YS00Yjc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_SRJoN-W4qDyxmTYIXsUuAE2k0Ht77bARBQEOFA8P-Y=&emci=fd47e855-3875-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=12b06f6a-4b75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9818364) Registration deadlines are right around the corner (Oregon's is October 15, less than a month away!) and people shouldn't wait until the last minute to get registered. [CHECK YOUR REGISTRATION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93025969/499106947/1364077512?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMmIwNmY2YS00Yjc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_SRJoN-W4qDyxmTYIXsUuAE2k0Ht77bARBQEOFA8P-Y=&emci=fd47e855-3875-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=12b06f6a-4b75-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9818364) I'm proud of the standard Oregon has helped set for universal vote-by-mail elections. I'm working hard to make sure _all_ Americans have the voting accessibility that we are lucky to have here in my home state. I saw firsthand how powerful it was for my parents when they heard a quick, genuine expression of thanks for their service. It not only gave them the strength to keep striving to be their best, but it also helped me appreciate the value of what our family was doing for our country.
That's why I know what a message of gratitude from military supporters like you can mean to our service members, especially at times when they're risking their lives on dangerous deployments far away from their families.

body:
I won’t ever trick you because your trust matters to me.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39109%2E3422442%2EOW7fnD)
Derek,
**_You matter_** --which is why I never demand your help with scammy language that scares or coerces you into donating. **It’s not my style.** My background is in consumer protection, so I make it a priority when asking you to donate that my messages are clear, honest, and informative.
Too many candidates and organizations use language like “Donate $5 today and it will be triple-matched,” “Warning: Payment incomplete,” or “We need 5,238 donors from YOUR zip code.” These tactics range from misleading to downright false, and they will _never_ be used by my team.
In Congress, I’ve led efforts to crack down on scam PACs, which can often be the worst offenders. Scam PACs are organizations that exist to steal money rather than to support a cause or candidate. Their expenditures--coming from Americans who think they’re chipping in for real causes--go solely to “consultants” who pocket the money. It’s a shameful way to make a quick buck.
**My style is to be frank with you.** We have less than 2 months until November. I need your help for Truth to Power to elect candidates who refuse to be swayed by corporate interests.
**[Truly, whatever zip code you’re in, I’d be so appreciative of your support! Can you make a contribution today ahead of our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240917?refcode=em20240917-39109&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39109_3422442_OW7fnD&akid=39109%2E3422442%2EOW7fnD)**

Thanks for reading, and thanks for supporting Truth to Power today.
Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240917-39109&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39109_3422442_OW7fnD&akid=39109%2E3422442%2EOW7fnD)**

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **
